products.tips_zh: 大量搬举重物时涂抹于背部下方。 疲惫的一天后涂抹按压手指、手腕、肩膀和颈部。 运动前后涂抹于足部和膝盖享活络与清凉的效果。
products.directions_zh: 外用：仅限外用。涂抹至所需部位。无需稀释。

products.benefits_en: Has a cool, minty aroma. Provides a cooling sensation to skin. Provides a cooling and comforting aroma during a massage. Rolls on smoothly for even, mess-free application. Gentle on sensitive skin.
products.intro_en: Lightweight and mess-free, it is perfect for tucking into a purse or gym bag so you can enjoy its cool, refreshing sensation on the go.
products.claims_en: Minty, piney, uplifting aroma. Provides a cooling sensation to the skin. Offers a cooling and comforting aroma during massage. Gentle formula suitable for sensitive skin.
products.tips_en: Apply to the lower back when doing heavy lifting. Rub on fingers, wrists, shoulders, and neck after a long day. Apply to feet and knees before and after exercise for an invigorating, cooling sensation.
products.directions_en: Topical use: For external use only. Apply to desired area. No dilution needed.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.ingredients_en: Wintergreen oil, Camphor oil, Peppermint oil, Ylang Ylang oil, Helichrysum oil, Blue Tansy oil, Blue (German) Chamomile oil, Osmanthus oil
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)

products.claims_zh: 按摩时，提供令人焕发活力，舒缓的香气 为皮肤带来凉爽的感觉 舒缓复方香膏
products.ingredients: 冬青精油、薄荷精油、尤加利精油、蓝艾菊精油、伊兰伊兰精油、永久花精油
products.intro_zh: 以润肤成分为基底，让您的皮肤在擦拭后柔润不油腻。
products.tips_zh: 涂抹于较大面积的部位并搭配按摩使用。 运动后，搭配按摩用于您的肩膀、下背部和腿部。 跑步前或后涂抹在膝盖和关节。
products.directions_zh: 于所需部位涂抹乳液。欲增加效果可在涂抹乳液前先使用舒缓复方精油。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。避免接触眼睛。不要使用于伤口或破损的皮肤上。使用后请勿过紧包扎或使用具有加热效果之加热垫。若于使用后产生红肿， 请立即停止使用。避免儿童直接触或误食 。如果不慎吞服，请立即寻求专业医疗人员协助 。
products.benefits_en: Combines Deep Blue essential oil blend and other soothing ingredients. Provides a cooling and soothing sensation to targeted areas. Leaves your skin soft and non-greasy with essential oils and moisturizing emollients.
products.intro_en: Formulated with a base of moisturizing ingredients, it leaves your skin soft and non-greasy after application. Wintergreen oil is commonly used in topical rubs and massage formulas because of the soothing properties of methyl salicylate, its main chemical constituent. Peppermint oil is high in menthol, which helps cool and soothe the skin; one of doTERRA's best-selling oils, its fresh, sweet aroma creates a pleasant atmosphere during exercise. Eucalyptus oil has a fresh aroma that creates a spa-like, soothing atmosphere and provides a soothing, cooling sensation when applied topically. Blue Tansy oil is rich in sabinene and benefits the skin when used in massage or applied topically; its royal blue hue gives Deep Blue its name and colour. Ylang Ylang oil, applied topically, helps create a calm, positive atmosphere. Helichrysum is a precious floral oil known for its subtle aroma and skin-rejuvenating benefits. All ingredients: Water, Gaultheria procumbens (wintergreen) leaf oil, Cinnamomum camphora linalooliferum leaf oil, menthol, cetearyl alcohol, Prunus amygdalus dulcis (sweet almond) oil, stearic acid, glyceryl stearate, PEG-100 stearate, Mentha piperita (peppermint) oil, Eucalyptus globulus leaf oil, caprylic/capric triglyceride, butylene glycol, Cananga odorata flower oil, Capsicum frutescens fruit extract, Chamomilla recutita (matricaria) flower oil, Tanacetum annuum flower oil, Helichrysum italicum flower oil, allantoin, Gardenia florida fruit extract, Osmanthus fragrans flower extract, Aloe barbadensis leaf juice, Chlorella vulgaris extract, retinyl ester, squalane, cetyl...
products.claims_en: Provides an invigorating, soothing aroma during massage. Provides a cooling sensation to the skin. Soothing blend rub.
products.tips_en: Apply to larger areas and combine with massage. After exercise, massage into your shoulders, lower back, and legs. Apply to knees and joints before or after a run.
products.directions_en: Apply lotion to desired area. For enhanced effect, apply Deep Blue essential oil before applying the lotion.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not apply to wounds or damaged skin. Do not bandage tightly or use with a heating pad after application. Discontinue use immediately if redness occurs. Keep out of reach of children to avoid direct contact or ingestion. If swallowed, seek professional medical help immediately.
products.ingredients_en: Wintergreen oil, Peppermint oil, Eucalyptus oil, Blue Tansy oil, Ylang Ylang oil, Helichrysum oil

products.claims_zh: 具有薄荷类、松树类、令人振奋的香气 给皮肤带来凉爽的感觉 按摩时，提供令人清凉和舒适的香气 舒缓口服多酚
products.skin: 可先稀释后用于易敏感肌肤
products.ingredients: 冬青精油、樟脑精油、薄荷精油、伊兰伊兰精油、永久花精油、蓝艾菊精油、蓝色（德国）洋甘菊精油、桂花精油
products.intro_zh: 舒适与清凉交汇   舒缓复方精油 舒缓复方的配方可为皮肤带来舒缓和清凉的效果，此复方是结合数款CPTG 精油，专为按摩而打造。这款 doTERRA 的必需品以其充满活力的香氛和舒缓的外用功效为您所有的日常活动提供支持。 冬青精油、樟脑精油和薄荷精油因其令人振奋的特性造就舒缓复方标志性的凉爽、刺激，而伊兰伊兰、永久花、蓝艾菊、德国洋甘菊和桂花则可舒缓和舒适您的肌肤。密密麻麻的行程或锻炼后，将舒缓复方精油涂抹在所需部位，可获得局部的舒缓效果，享受清凉、充满活力的香气。您还可以用基底油稀释几滴舒缓复方精油，作为清凉和舒适身体按摩的一部分。
products.tips_zh: 运动前后按摩到目标部位。 劳累一天后，按摩下背部。 经过一整天的工作后，涂抹于指关节、手腕、肩膀和颈部。
products.directions_zh: 外用：在所需区域涂抹1-2滴。用基底油稀释以降低皮肤过敏可能。请参阅下面的注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 可能引起肌肤过敏。请放置孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a cool, minty aroma Provides a soothing, cooling feeling to skin Provides a comforting sensation during massage
products.intro_en: Where Comfort Meets Cool — Deep Blue Soothing Blend. The Deep Blue formula provides a soothing, cooling effect on the skin; this blend combines several CPTG essential oils and is designed specifically for massage. A doTERRA essential, its invigorating aroma and soothing topical benefits support all your daily activities. Wintergreen, Camphor, and Peppermint create Deep Blue's signature cool, tingling sensation with their invigorating properties, while Ylang Ylang, Helichrysum, Blue Tansy, German Chamomile, and Osmanthus help soothe and comfort your skin. After a packed schedule or a workout, apply Deep Blue to desired areas for localized soothing and enjoy its cool, invigorating aroma. You can also dilute a few drops of Deep Blue with a carrier oil as part of a cooling, comforting full-body massage.
products.claims_en: Minty, piney, uplifting aroma. Provides a cooling sensation to the skin. Offers a cooling and comforting aroma during massage. Soothing polyphenols for internal use.
products.tips_en: Massage onto target areas before and after exercise. Massage into the lower back after a tiring day. Apply to knuckles, wrists, shoulders, and neck after a long day of work.
products.directions_en: Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.ingredients_en: Wintergreen oil, Camphor oil, Peppermint oil, Ylang Ylang oil, Helichrysum oil, Blue Tansy oil, Blue (German) Chamomile oil, Osmanthus oil
products.skin_en: Dilute before applying to sensitive skin

products.name_zh: 舒缓复方香膏 天然健康产品
products.claims_zh: 加拿大 NHP 外用镇痛产品：暂时缓解肌肉和关节疼痛（含植物性薄荷醇、水杨酸甲酯、樟脑，NPN 80111485）；暂时缓解与单纯背痛、扭伤、拉伤和关节炎有关的疼痛 注入了蕴含CPTG 专业纯正检测认证的舒缓复方精油 以保湿润肤剂为基底，用后肌肤柔软不油腻 带来清凉舒缓的感受 *舒缓复方香膏已注册为天然健康产品 (NHP)：NPN 80111485。有关公司产品合规词汇，请参阅合规词汇一览表。 主要功效 暂时缓解与单纯背痛、扭伤、拉伤和关节炎有关的疼痛 注入了蕴含CPTG 专业纯正检测认证的舒缓复方精油 以保湿润肤剂为基底，用后肌肤柔软不油腻 带来清凉舒缓的感受 *舒缓复方香膏已注册为天然健康产品 (NHP)：NPN 80111485。有关公司产品合规词汇，请参阅合规词汇一览表。
products.intro_zh: 舒缓复方香膏 (天然健康产品) 注入了舒缓复方精油，舒缓复方香膏可针对性暂时缓解肌肉和关节的疼痛。这新款的外用镇痛香膏采用方便、固体膏状，涂抹后无需洗手或作特别善后。 天然健康产品编号(NPN)为 80111485。 舒缓复方香膏含植物性薄荷醇、水杨酸甲酯和樟脑，是一款易于使用、可顺畅滑动、提供深层且凉爽的舒缓作用并同时保湿的产品，植物性润肤剂让您的皮肤看起来柔软而不油腻。舒缓、方便且有效的舒缓复方香膏是浴室柜或健身包中不可或缺的补充，可在运动前、后或运动期间使用。
products.directions_zh: 均匀地涂抹少量于所需之处，每天最多涂抹3-4 次。揉搓和/或按摩，直至没有明显残留于皮肤上。 2-12 岁的儿童和青少年：涂抹时应由成人监督。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。避免接触眼睛或粘膜。一旦接触，请用水彻底冲洗。请勿用于伤口或受损肌肤部位。涂抹后请勿用绷带紧系。请勿加热，例如电热敷垫，有可能会过度刺激或灼伤皮肤。孕妇、哺乳中妇女或服用抗凝药物，请在使用前咨询医师。放置处请远离孩童。若误食请尽速就医或联络当地毒药物咨询中心。如果出现过敏、皮疹、和/或灼热不适，或者如果症状在几天内恶化或持续出现，请停止使用并咨询医师。如果您感到疼痛、肿胀或起泡，请立即停止使用并寻求医疗救助。 用途暂时缓解与以下一项或多项相关的肌肉和关节疼痛：单纯背痛、腰痛、拉伤和扭伤（涉及肌肉、肌腱和/或韧带）和关节炎。
products.benefits_en: Delivers temporary relief of aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with simple backache, sprains, strains, and arthritis Infused with Deep Blue essential oil blend of CPTG Certified Pure Tested Grade essential oils Includes moisturizing emollients that leave your skin soft and non-greasy Creates a cooling and soothing sensation *Deep Blue Stick is registered as a Natural Health Product (NHP): NPN 80111485. For a complete list of approved claims and benefits, see the Approved Claims List. Primary Benefits Delivers temporary relief of aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with simple backache, sprains, strains, and arthritis Infused with Deep Blue essential oil blend of CPTG Certified Pure Tested Grade essential oils Includes moisturizing emollients that leave your skin
products.intro_en: Deep Blue Stick (Natural Health Product). Infused with Deep Blue Soothing Blend, Deep Blue Stick provides targeted, temporary relief of muscle and joint pain. This new topical analgesic comes in a convenient solid stick, so there is no need to wash your hands or clean up after application. Natural Product Number (NPN) 80111485. Containing plant-derived menthol, methyl salicylate, and camphor, Deep Blue Stick is easy to use, glides on smoothly, and delivers deep, cooling relief while moisturizing; plant-based emollients leave your skin looking soft and non-greasy. Soothing, convenient, and effective, Deep Blue Stick is an essential addition to your bathroom cabinet or gym bag, for use before, during, or after exercise.
products.claims_en: Canadian NHP topical analgesic: temporarily relieves muscle and joint pain (contains plant-derived menthol, methyl salicylate, and camphor; NPN 80111485). Temporarily relieves pain associated with simple backache, sprains, strains, and arthritis. Infused with CPTG Certified Pure Tested Deep Blue Soothing Blend. Moisturizing emollient base leaves skin soft and non-greasy. Provides a cooling, soothing sensation. Deep Blue Stick is registered as a Natural Health Product (NHP): NPN 80111485.
products.directions_en: Apply a small amount evenly to the affected area, up to 3–4 times daily. Rub and/or massage until no visible residue remains on the skin. Children and adolescents 2–12 years: use under adult supervision.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membranes; in case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not apply to wounds or damaged skin. Do not bandage tightly after application. Do not apply heat, such as a heating pad, as this may cause excessive irritation or burning of the skin. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking anticoagulants, consult a physician before use. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Centre right away. Stop use and consult a physician if irritation, rash, and/or burning occurs, or if symptoms worsen or persist for more than a few days. Stop use immediately and seek medical attention if you experience pain, swelling, or blistering. Uses: Temporarily relieves muscle and joint pain associated with one or more of the following: simple backache, lower back pain, strains and sprains (involving muscles, tendons, and/or ligaments), and arthritis.

products.name_zh: 丁香精油 (天然健康产品)
products.claims_zh: 芳疗中用于帮助缓解扭伤、拉伤及类风湿关节炎相关的关节和肌肉疼痛
products.skin: 必须稀释后外用
products.aroma: 辛香、温热、木质亦含有皮革香气
products.intro_zh: 丁香精油效果多元可解决多种问题。为散发温暖木质香气的精油。天然健康产品编号(NPN)为 80073542。
products.tips_zh: 用于芳香疗法可帮助减轻扭伤、拉伤和类风湿性关节炎造成的关节与肌肉疼痛。用于芳香疗法可帮助舒缓感冒与咳嗽。
products.cautions_zh: 请勿用于口腔。请置于孩童伸手不及处。仅限外用。请勿接触眼睛与黏膜，若不慎进入请以植物油彻底洗净。若不慎误食，请立即联络紧急医疗服务或当地毒药物防治咨询中心。若具有癫痫或气喘病史请先咨询医师，若使用后症状加重也请联络医师。怀孕或哺乳者请勿使用本产品。涂抹区域于24小时至48小时内请勿接触阳光。倘若出现恶心、晕眩、头痛或其他过敏症状，请停止使用。欲长期使用请先咨询医疗专业。
products.intro_en: Clove oil is versatile and can be used to address a variety of needs. It is an essential oil with a warm, woody aroma. Natural Product Number (NPN) 80073542.
products.claims_en: Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis.
products.tips_en: Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve colds and coughs.
products.cautions_en: Do not use in the mouth. Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with vegetable oil. If swallowed, call emergency medical services or a Poison Control Centre immediately. Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you have a history of epilepsy or asthma, or if symptoms worsen after use. Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid exposing the application area to sunlight for 24 to 48 hours. Discontinue use if nausea, dizziness, headache, or other hypersensitivity/allergy reactions occur. Consult a health care practitioner for prolonged use.
products.aroma_en: Spicy, warm, woody, with a leathery note
products.skin_en: Dilute before topical use

products.name_zh: 丝柏精油 (天然健康产品)
products.claims_zh: 芳疗中用于帮助缓解扭伤、拉伤及类风湿关节炎相关的关节和肌肉疼痛
products.skin: 可直接涂抹（无需稀释）
products.intro_zh: 丝柏精油萃取自高大常青树种的枝条散发清新洁净的香气，涂抹使用可帮助减缓扭伤和拉伤造成的关节与肌肉疼痛。天然健康产品编号(NPN)为 80060929。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 涂抹丝柏精油能舒缓干燥肌肤与清洁。 准备长跑前涂抹于足部和腿部进行能量按摩。 搭配薰衣草精油和马郁兰精油一同使用进行颈部的舒缓按摩。 著手园艺前涂抹两滴丝柏精油于胸口带来活络香气。 辛苦工作的一天后泡澡时倒入1/2杯镁盐与滴入一滴丝柏精油尽情放松。 居家用 扩香三滴丝柏精油和三滴莱姆精油散发活络香气。 擦拭各式表面前可先取一温水浸湿之抹布滴入两滴精油增强清洁功效。 调理级用 用于芳香疗法帮助舒缓感冒与咳嗽。 用于芳香疗法可帮助减轻扭伤、拉伤和类风湿性关节炎造成的关节与肌肉疼痛。
products.cautions_zh: 请勿用于口腔。请置于孩童伸手不及处。仅限外用。请勿接触眼睛与黏膜，若不慎进入请以植物油彻底洗净。若不慎误食，请立即联络紧急医疗服务或当地毒药物防治咨询中心。若具有癫痫或气喘病史请先咨询医师，若使用后症状加重也请联络医师。怀孕或哺乳者请勿使用本产品。涂抹区域请勿接触阳光。倘若出现恶心、晕眩、头痛或其他过敏症状，请停止使用。欲长期使用请先咨询医疗专业。
products.intro_en: Cypress oil is extracted from the branches of a tall evergreen tree and has a fresh, clean aroma. Applied topically, it can help relieve joint and muscle pain caused by sprains and strains. Natural Product Number (NPN) 80060929.
products.claims_en: Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Apply Cypress oil to soothe and cleanse dry skin. Apply to feet and legs for an energizing massage before a long run. Use with Lavender and Marjoram for a soothing neck massage. Apply two drops to the chest for an invigorating aroma before gardening. After a hard day's work, add 1/2 cup of Epsom salt and one drop of Cypress to a bath and relax. Home: Diffuse three drops of Cypress with three drops of Lime for an invigorating aroma. Add two drops to a cloth dampened with warm water to boost cleaning before wiping surfaces. Therapeutic use: Used in aromatherapy to help relieve colds and coughs. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis.
products.cautions_en: Do not use in the mouth. Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with vegetable oil. If swallowed, call emergency medical services or a Poison Control Centre immediately. Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you have a history of epilepsy or asthma, or if symptoms worsen after use. Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid exposing the application area to sunlight. Discontinue use if nausea, dizziness, headache, or other hypersensitivity/allergy reactions occur. Consult a health care practitioner for prolonged use.

products.intro_zh: 柔和舒缓   快乐鼠尾草精油 快乐鼠尾草是一种著名的草本植物，自古以来就因其舒缓的香气和对皮肤的镇静功效而被大众使用。作为注册的天然健康产品，doTERRA 快乐鼠尾草精油因其镇静特性和在芳香疗法中的广泛应用而备受推崇。 快乐鼠尾草的香氛清新、草本且舒缓，其精油可外用于肌肤和头发，具有滋养功效。快乐鼠尾草深受女性喜爱，尤其在每月特别的期间，用于腹部按摩更能带来愉悦的芳香体验。 为了充分发挥快乐鼠尾草精油的调理级功效，建议每日或睡前使用喷雾器扩香，营造放松的环境。在芳香疗法中使用 doTERRA 快乐鼠尾草精油，有助缓解头痛、季节性咳嗽和感冒症状，以及偶尔出现的消化不适。在芳香按摩中加入快乐鼠尾草精油，则有助缓解扭伤、拉伤和类风湿性关节炎引起的关节和肌肉疼痛。 doTERRA 快乐鼠尾草精油已注册为天然健康产品 (NHP)：NPN 80060984。
products.tips_zh: 取 3-5滴涂抹于腹部，进行舒缓按摩。 在浴缸水中加入快乐鼠尾草精油，享受放松的沐浴体验。 与洗发精或护发素混合后使用，促进头发和头皮健康。 混合基底油使用，舒缓或焕活肌肤。 调理级用 在芳香疗法中用作镇静剂和安神剂。 在芳香疗法中用于缓解头痛。 在芳香疗法中用于缓解感冒和咳嗽。 在芳香疗法中用于缓解轻微的皮肤刺激、割伤、擦伤和烧伤。 在芳香疗法中用作驱风剂和解痉剂，以缓解消化不适症状。 芳香疗法中用于缓解扭伤、拉伤和类风湿性关节炎引起的关节和肌肉疼痛。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。请参阅下方其他注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 请勿用于口腔。请置于孩童伸手不及处。仅限外用。请勿接触眼睛与黏膜，若不慎进入请以植物油彻底洗净。若不慎误食，请立即联络紧急医疗服务或当地毒药物防治咨询中心。若具有癫痫或气喘病史请先咨询医师，若使用后症状加重也请联络医师。怀孕或哺乳者请勿使用本产品。涂抹区域于24小时至48小时内请勿接触阳光。倘若出现恶心、晕眩、头痛或其他过敏症状，请停止使用。欲长期使用请先咨询医疗专业。

products.intro_en: Gentle and Soothing — Clary Sage Oil. Clary Sage is a renowned herb that has been used since ancient times for its soothing aroma and calming benefits for the skin. As a registered Natural Health Product, doTERRA Clary Sage oil is highly valued for its calming properties and wide use in aromatherapy. Clary Sage has a fresh, herbaceous, soothing aroma, and the oil can be applied topically to skin and hair for nourishing benefits. Clary Sage is a favourite among women, especially during that special time of the month, when it offers a pleasant aromatic experience in an abdominal massage. To make the most of Clary Sage's therapeutic benefits, diffuse it daily or at bedtime to create a relaxing environment. Used in aromatherapy, doTERRA Clary Sage helps relieve headaches, seasonal coughs and cold symptoms, and occasional digestive discomfort. Added to an aromatherapy massage, Clary Sage helps relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis. doTERRA Clary Sage oil is registered as a Natural Health Product (NHP): NPN 80060984.

Used in aromatherapy to help relieve minor skin irritations. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve digestive discomfort.
products.tips_en: Apply 3–5 drops to the abdomen for a soothing massage. Add Clary Sage to bath water for a relaxing bathing experience. Mix with shampoo or conditioner to promote healthy-looking hair and scalp. Combine with a carrier oil to soothe or revitalize skin. Therapeutic use: Used in aromatherapy as a sedative and calmative. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve headaches. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve colds and coughs. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve minor skin irritations, cuts, scrapes, and burns. Used in aromatherapy as a carminative and antispasmodic to help relieve symptoms of digestive discomfort. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: Do not use in the mouth. Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with vegetable oil. If swallowed, call emergency medical services or a Poison Control Centre immediately. Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you have a history of epilepsy or asthma, or if symptoms worsen after use. Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid exposing the application area to sunlight for 24 to 48 hours. Discontinue use if nausea, dizziness, headache, or other hypersensitivity/allergy reactions occur. Consult a health care practitioner for prolonged use.

products.tips_zh: 用于芳香疗法可安定神经具镇静效果。 用于芳香疗法可帮助减轻扭伤、拉伤和类风湿性关节炎造成的关节与肌肉疼痛。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。

products.claims_en: Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis; calming and sedative. Acts as a calmative. Helps relieve some joint and muscle pain.

products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Do not use in the mouth. Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with vegetable oil. If swallowed, call emergency medical services or a Poison Control Centre immediately. Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you have a history of epilepsy or asthma, or if symptoms worsen after use. Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid exposing the application area to sunlight for 24 to 48 hours. Discontinue use if nausea, dizziness, headache, or other hypersensitivity/allergy reactions occur. Consult a health care practitioner for prolonged use.

products.intro_zh: 薄荷般清新   薄荷精油 (天然健康产品) 薄荷精油是我们最畅销的精油之一，该款精油集卓越风味、香氛和治疗功效于一身，故拥有诸多效用。作为已注册的天然健康产品，doTERRA薄荷精油在芳香疗法中具有许多的应用方式。 天然健康产品编号80072499 CPTG Certified Pure Tested Grade®专业纯正检测认证薄荷精油具有独特的振奋香气，有助营造正向且活力鼓舞的氛围。由于薄荷精油富含薄荷醇，因此在外用涂抹时能带来清凉效果，并在按摩时提供舒缓感受。薄荷同时能为甜点和饮品增添清新、薄荷风味，并经常用于牙膏和口香糖作为口腔护理之效。 在草本疗法中，薄荷精油有助舒缓消化不适的症状和恶心感受。扩香使用或用于芳香疗法外用涂抹时，doTERRA薄荷精油的清凉、清新香气具镇静效果，并有助舒缓感冒与咳嗽相关症状。
products.tips_zh: 扩香使用或将一滴薄荷精油滴在手掌中嗅吸。 按摩用于您的肩颈部位，以享清新香氛。 将一滴精油加入洗发精或润发乳，进行振奋人心的头皮按摩。 将一滴薄荷精油加入您喜爱的菜肴中。 调理级用 用于芳香疗法可安定神经具镇静效果。 用于芳香疗法减缓胀气与痉挛等消化不良的症状。 用于芳香疗法帮助舒缓感冒与咳嗽。 用于芳香疗法帮助减缓扭伤、拉伤和类风湿性关节炎引起的关节与肌肉疼痛。 传统上用于草本疗法以舒缓恶心和呕吐症状。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的扩散器中使用三到四滴。 芳香使用：将1-6滴未经稀释的精油滴于卫生纸上，每日缓缓嗅吸三次。 口腔护理：将2滴或以上的精油加入水中、糖块或doTERRA素食胶囊。一天至多使用16滴精油。 外用涂抹：将1滴精油与5毫升的分馏椰子油混合。每日三次涂抹于肌肤上，抑或是每日按摩使用一次。搓揉或按摩于肌肤直至精油完全吸收。请勿使用未经稀释的精油。
products.cautions_zh: 请放至于儿童伸手不及处。请勿接触眼睛与黏膜；若不慎进入请以植物油彻底洗净。若不慎误食，请立即联络紧急医疗服务或当地毒药物防治咨询中心。若具有癫痫、气喘、贫血、胆结石、食道裂孔疝气或胃食道逆流病史，抑或是使用后症状加重，请咨询医师。怀孕或哺乳者请勿使用本产品。涂抹区域请勿在涂抹后接触阳光。有些人可能会出现胃食道逆流。倘若出现过敏反应、恶心、晕眩、头痛或其他不适症状，请停止使用。若您的肌肤有破损、发炎或敏感，请勿使用本产品。本产品仅供偶尔使用。

products.intro_en: Minty Fresh — Peppermint Oil (Natural Health Product). Peppermint is one of our best-selling essential oils, combining outstanding flavour, aroma, and therapeutic benefits for a wide range of uses. As a registered Natural Health Product, doTERRA Peppermint oil has many applications in aromatherapy. Natural Product Number 80072499. CPTG Certified Pure Tested Grade® Peppermint oil has a distinctive, uplifting aroma that helps create a positive, energizing atmosphere. Because it is high in menthol, Peppermint provides a cooling effect when applied topically and a soothing sensation during massage. Peppermint also adds a fresh, minty flavour to desserts and beverages, and is commonly used in toothpaste and chewing gum for oral care. In herbal medicine, Peppermint oil helps relieve symptoms of digestive discomfort and nausea. When diffused or applied topically in aromatherapy, the cool, fresh aroma of doTERRA Peppermint has a calming effect and helps relieve symptoms associated with colds and coughs.
products.claims_en: Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis; calming and sedative; cooling and refreshing. Fresh, uplifting, energizing aroma. Provides a cooling, refreshing sensation. Adds a minty, fresh flavour to water or dishes. Used in aromatherapy as a sedative and calmative. Used in aromatherapy as a carminative and antispasmodic to help relieve symptoms of digestive discomfort. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve colds and coughs. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis. Traditionally used in herbal medicine to help relieve nausea and vomiting. doTERRA Peppermint oil is registered as a Natural Health Product (NHP): NPN 80072499.
products.tips_en: Diffuse, or place one drop of Peppermint in your palms and inhale. Massage into your neck and shoulders for a refreshing aroma. Add one drop to shampoo or conditioner for an invigorating scalp massage. Add one drop of Peppermint to your favourite dish. Therapeutic use: Used in aromatherapy as a sedative and calmative. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve symptoms of digestive discomfort such as flatulence and cramps. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve colds and coughs. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve joint and muscle pain associated with sprains, strains, and rheumatoid arthritis. Traditionally used in herbal medicine to help relieve nausea and vomiting.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Aromatic use: Place 1–6 drops of undiluted oil on a tissue and inhale slowly, three times daily. Oral use: Add 2 or more drops to water, a sugar cube, or a doTERRA Veggie Cap. Do not exceed 16 drops per day. Topical use: Mix 1 drop with 5 mL of Fractionated Coconut Oil. Apply to skin three times daily, or use once daily in a massage. Rub or massage into skin until fully absorbed. Do not use undiluted.
products.cautions_en: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with vegetable oil. If swallowed, call emergency medical services or a Poison Control Centre immediately. Consult a health care practitioner if you have a history of epilepsy, asthma, anemia, gallstones, hiatal hernia, or gastroesophageal reflux, or if symptoms worsen after use. Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid exposing the application area to sunlight after use. Some people may experience heartburn. Discontinue use if hypersensitivity/allergy, nausea, dizziness, headache, or other discomfort occurs. Do not apply to broken, inflamed, or sensitive skin. This product is intended for occasional use only.

products.intro_zh: 岩兰草精油有著温暖甜美的木质和泥土香氛。岩兰草精油由高杆岩兰草强壮的根部蒸气蒸馏而来，有著“泥土香水”和“宁静之油”的昵称，用来形容这种以沉稳镇静特性而著称的精油十分恰当。doTERRA将岩兰草精油与分馏椰子油混合注入滚珠瓶，涂抹使用可抚平和滋润肌肤，非常适合晚间或护肤保养程序中使用。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把呵护系列-岩兰草精油纳入收藏? doTERRA呵护系列-岩兰草精油与 15 毫升的单方岩兰草精油有相同珍贵的功效，便携式的滚珠瓶更是优化了涂抹使用精油的体验。doTERRA 呵护系列-岩兰草精油以分馏椰子油为基础进行预先稀释，是敏感肌人士的温和替代品，无论是用于日常护肤程序还是舒适的睡前按摩，都可以无拘无束地滚涂。

products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把丝柏精油纳入收藏? 丝柏精油的主要单萜（化学成分之一）是α-蒎烯，它是其他极富动力如乳香精油，黄杉精油和永久花精油的相同成分。这种单萜有助于维持健康肤色同时使皮肤焕发活力。丝柏精油具有高含量的柠檬烯—柑橘类精油中的关键成分—还有3-蒈烯，丝柏精油结合两种化学成分，既有深层清洁特性又有独特的平稳大地同时振奋的香气。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 用分馏椰子油稀释丝柏和葡萄柚精油各一滴进行活络按摩散发提振香气。 于爽肤水中加入一至两滴丝柏精油，有助于平衡肌肤水分并维持肌肤光泽健康。 长跑前涂抹一至两滴丝柏精油于足部和腿部，可增强动力。 园艺活动前于胸前涂抹两至三滴丝柏精油，可使人精力充沛。 居家用 混合三滴丝柏精油和两滴莱姆精油在家扩香营造振奋的香气和明亮的氛围。

products.desc_en: Why should I add Cypress to my collection? products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.intro_zh: 从新鲜薄荷叶子蒸馏而来的doTERRA最畅销精油之一—薄荷精油。最受喜爱、清凉、薄荷的薄荷精油结合质地轻盈的分馏椰子油而制成呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油。这款薄荷滚珠精油具有您喜爱的活力外用功效，此款熟悉的精油已预先稀释，打开瓶盖就能立即涂抹，非常适合儿童和皮肤敏感的人使用。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油纳入收藏? 呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油富含桉油醇（1,8-桉树脑），以局部涂抹的益处而闻名。其简易涂抹的方式，您可以随身携带呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油，随时随地为您带来活力香氛和清凉的肌肤感觉。将呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油按摩到颈部或后肩，进行舒缓按摩同时散发放松的清新香气。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 将呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油涂抹到颈部和肩部，进行舒缓按摩，散发放松的香氛。 学习或刚起床时涂抹呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油于太阳穴，有助提神醒脑。 进行户外活动前涂抹呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油，散发愉悦、持久的香氛。
products.directions_zh: 外用: 将滚珠精油涂抹到所需部位。请参阅以下的注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a refreshing, stimulating, energizing aroma Provides a cooling, refreshing sensation Gentle on sensitive skin
products.intro_en: Distilled from fresh peppermint leaves, Peppermint is one of doTERRA's best-selling essential oils. doTERRA Touch Peppermint combines beloved, cool, minty Peppermint with lightweight Fractionated Coconut Oil. This roll-on delivers the energizing topical benefits you love in a familiar oil that is pre-diluted and ready to apply as soon as you open the cap—ideal for children and those with sensitive skin.
products.claims_en: Fresh, stimulating, energizing aroma. Provides a cooling, refreshing sensation. Gentle on sensitive skin.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Apply doTERRA Touch Peppermint to the neck and shoulders for a soothing massage with a relaxing aroma. Apply to the temples while studying or after waking up to help you feel alert. Apply before outdoor activities for a pleasant, long-lasting aroma.
products.directions_en: Topical use: Roll onto desired area. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)
products.desc_en: Why should I add doTERRA Touch Peppermint to my collection? doTERRA Touch Peppermint is rich in eucalyptol (1,8-cineole), known for its topical benefits. Thanks to its easy application, you can carry doTERRA Touch Peppermint with you for an energizing aroma and cooling sensation anytime, anywhere. Massage it into the neck or back of the shoulders for a soothing massage while releasing a relaxing, fresh aroma.

products.claims_zh: 具有温暖，辛辣，大自然的香气 于食谱中添加以享姜黄风味 使皮肤干净，健康
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.aroma: 温热、辛香、大地香气、木香
products.intro_zh: 姜黄精油在印度阿育吠陀传统中拥有悠久的实践历史，是个人健康的英雄。这种多功能精油具有卓越的芳香和护肤功效，可用于家庭烹饪，适合用于日常生活的任何事务。
products.desc_zh: 姜黄以其在扩香或在舒缓按摩期间散发的扑实香氛而闻名，但厨房才是它的主场。姜黄精油以独特的风味大大地增强了咖哩、汤和其他菜肴的风味。在一杯水或热茶中加入一滴姜黄精油绝对是享受其浓郁味道的另一种绝佳方式。姜黄精油是护肤品中的无名瑰宝，与洗面奶或保湿霜结合使用，可以帮助促进肌肤清澈、光滑、容光焕发。
products.tips_zh: 扩香使用散发温暖、朴实、充满活力的香氛。 在您喜爱的茶、饮料或食谱中加入一滴姜黄精油以增强风味。 在您的日常护肤品或面膜中添加一滴，皮肤整体的健康光泽。 健身运动后，在舒缓按摩时滴一滴。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服：取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a warm, spicy, earthy, aroma Adds the unique flavor of turmeric to water and recipes Supports clean, healthy-looking skin
products.intro_en: With a long history of use in India's Ayurvedic tradition, Turmeric oil is a hero of personal wellness. This versatile oil offers outstanding aromatic and skin care benefits, can be used in home cooking, and suits just about anything in your daily life.
products.claims_en: Warm, spicy, earthy aroma. Add to recipes for turmeric flavour. Promotes clean, healthy-looking skin.
products.tips_en: Diffuse for a warm, earthy, energizing aroma. Add one drop of Turmeric to your favourite tea, beverage, or recipe to enhance flavour. Add one drop to your daily skin care product or face mask for an overall healthy-looking glow. Add one drop to a soothing massage after a workout.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)
products.desc_en: Turmeric is known for the earthy aroma it releases when diffused or used in a soothing massage, but the kitchen is where it truly shines. Turmeric oil greatly enhances the flavour of curries, soups, and other dishes with its distinctive taste. Adding one drop of Turmeric to a glass of water or hot tea is another excellent way to enjoy its rich flavour. Turmeric is an unsung gem of skin care—combine it with your cleanser or moisturizer to help promote clear, smooth, radiant-looking skin.

products.claims_zh: 具有木质，通畅，提振的香气 可以帮助清洁皮肤和头皮 活化肌肤外观 为皮肤带来凉爽的感觉 清新空气
products.skin: 可先稀释后用于易敏感肌肤
products.origin: 瓶中水疗   尤加利精油 尤加利树为一种生长快速、会开花的常绿乔木，澳洲拥有超过700 种的尤加利树。
products.intro_zh: 瓶中水疗   尤加利精油 尤加利树为一种生长快速、会开花的常绿乔木，澳洲拥有超过700 种的尤加利树。作为桃金娘科 (Myrtaceae) 的一员，此树种可以长至18米高和4.5米宽。dōTERRA选用了五个独特树种以打造尤加利精油专利配方：澳洲尤加利精油 (Eucalyptus radiata)、多苞叶尤加利精油 (E. polybractea)、柯奇尤加利精油 (E. kochii)、桉树 (E. loxophleba) 以及蓝桉 (E. globulus)。 这5种物种的主要化学成分是 桉油醇(1,8-桉树脑)，亦是此款精油众多功效的来源。当中包括有 效的表面和皮肤清洁特性，以及扩香时散发的清新、香氛，营 造焕发活力的氛围。芳香和局部涂抹都可以享受尤加利清澈、清新 的香氛，或在进行舒缓按摩时使用，以获得激励的香气。
products.tips_zh: 扩香尤加利精油或滴数滴于手掌，扣住口鼻并深深嗅吸以带来鼓舞、活力的感受。 将一至两滴尤加利精油滴于淋浴间地板，享受水疗般的舒服体验。 进行舒缓按摩期间，将尤加利精油与基底油或乳液混合使用。 可将尤加利精油作为空气清新剂以及房间除臭剂。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能引起肌肤过敏。请放置孩童伸手不及处。怀孕或接受治疗者请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。请将本产品放在儿童接触不到的地方。如果意外摄入，请立即致电毒物控制中心或医生，并告知他们该产品含有尤加利精油。
products.benefits_en: Creates a calm, spa-like atmosphere Provides a cooling sensation to skin Helps promote clean, healthy-looking skin Cleansing to surfaces Freshens air
products.intro_en: Spa in a Bottle — Eucalyptus Oil. The eucalyptus is a fast-growing, flowering evergreen tree, and Australia is home to more than 700 species. A member of the Myrtaceae family, it can grow up to 18 metres tall and 4.5 metres wide. doTERRA selected five distinct species to create its proprietary Eucalyptus blend: Eucalyptus radiata, E. polybractea, E. kochii, E. loxophleba, and E. globulus. The main chemical constituent of these five species is eucalyptol (1,8-cineole), the source of many of this oil's benefits. These include effective surface- and skin-cleansing properties, as well as a fresh aroma when diffused that creates a revitalizing atmosphere. Enjoy Eucalyptus's clear, fresh aroma aromatically or topically, or use it during a soothing massage for an invigorating scent.
products.claims_en: Woody, clear, uplifting aroma. Can help cleanse skin and scalp. Revitalizes the appearance of skin. Provides a cooling sensation to the skin. Freshens the air.
products.tips_en: Diffuse Eucalyptus or place a few drops in your palms, cup them over your nose and mouth, and inhale deeply for an uplifting, energizing feeling. Place one to two drops on the shower floor for a spa-like experience. Combine Eucalyptus with a carrier oil or lotion during a soothing massage. Use Eucalyptus as an air freshener and room deodorizer.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Keep this product out of reach of children. If accidentally ingested, call a Poison Control Centre or physician immediately and tell them the product contains eucalyptus oil.
products.origin_en: The eucalyptus is a fast-growing, flowering evergreen tree; Australia is home to more than 700 species of eucalyptus.
products.skin_en: Dilute before applying to sensitive skin

products.claims_zh: 可以滋润皮肤，使肤色均匀 使肤色明亮 按摩时，提供大自然的香气 于水或食谱中添加以享草本味 具有镇定和朴实的香气 清新空气 清洁表面
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.aroma: 黑醋香、干净、木质、香料味
products.intro_zh: 从杜松树的浆果中提取的杜松浆果精油因其丰富的用途和益处而闻名。局部涂抹杜松浆果精油在皮肤，可起清洁和爽肤之用，有助提亮肤色。其清新、木质、辛辣的香氛能营造干净、平静的氛围。扩香杜松浆果精油打造朴实的环境。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 清洁脸部后涂抹一滴杜松浆果精油以作爽肤水使用。 取一滴杜松浆果精油涂抹肌肤促进明亮的肤质。 每日运动后用杜松浆果精油搭配分馏椰子油涂抹。 以杜松浆果精油搭配漱口水使用维持牙龈、牙齿洁净和口腔的清新。 食用 于您的绿蔬果昔或果昔加入一至两滴杜松浆果精油享受清爽的口感。 居家用 睡前扩香杜松浆果精油以享镇静与安稳的天然香气。 搭配柑橘类精油扩香杜松浆果精油以干净的香氛清新空气。 于浸泡温水的抹布滴入杜松浆果精油再擦拭门把和其他表面加强清洁功效。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Can moisturize skin
products.intro_en: Derived from the berries of the juniper tree, Juniper Berry oil is known for its many uses and benefits. Applied topically, Juniper Berry cleanses and tones the skin and helps brighten the complexion. Its fresh, woody, spicy aroma creates a clean, calm atmosphere. Diffuse Juniper Berry to create a grounding environment.
products.claims_en: Can moisturize skin and even out skin tone. Brightens the complexion. Provides an earthy aroma during massage. Add to water or recipes for an herbaceous flavour. Calming, grounding aroma. Freshens the air. Cleanses surfaces.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Apply one drop of Juniper Berry after cleansing your face as a toner. Apply one drop to the skin to promote a brighter complexion. Apply with Fractionated Coconut Oil after daily exercise. Use Juniper Berry with mouthwash to maintain clean gums and teeth and fresh breath. Food: Add one to two drops to your green smoothie or fruit smoothie for a refreshing taste. Home: Diffuse Juniper Berry before bed for a calming, grounding natural aroma. Diffuse with citrus oils to freshen the air with a clean scent. Add Juniper Berry to a cloth soaked in warm water and wipe doorknobs and other surfaces for enhanced cleaning.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)

products.claims_zh: 稀释后清洁指甲床，使指甲外观健康 稀释后可为肌肤带来清爽的感觉 与基底油稀释使用，按摩时，散发出令人放松，振奋的香气 于食谱中添加以享草本，柑橘类，甘苦味道 具有令人愉悦的草本香气
products.skin: 稀释后局部使用 清洁表面
products.intro_zh: 柠檬草是一种高大的常年生植物，具有微妙的柑橘味，常用于亚洲食物以点缀汤、茶、咖哩、肉类和海鲜的风味。柠檬草精油因其清洁功效常用于肌肤保养产品。柠檬草散发草本香气有助集中注意力亦相当适合按摩疗法使用。 扩香柠檬草精油或进行放松按摩时与分馏椰子油混合使用，会有清新、令人振奋的香氛。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把柠檬草精油纳入收藏? 柠檬草精油的化学成分包括香叶醛和橙花醛，都是属于醛的家族。通常，醛以其特有强烈的香味而闻名，这就是为什么柠檬草精油拥有清新、柑橘和草本类香氛的原因。醛还具有清洁表面的功效，柠檬草精油因而非常适合用于清洁皮肤和常用表面。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 在您的日常洁面乳中加入一到两滴柠檬草精油，以促进清洁皮肤。 用一至两滴柠檬草精油搭配一至两滴茶树精油涂抹于脚趾甲保持干净健康的外观。 运动过后以5滴分馏椰子油稀释一滴柠檬草精油涂抹使用带来舒畅感。 以一滴柠檬草精油搭配5滴分馏椰子油涂抹于皮肤进行舒缓按摩。 食用 滴一至两滴柠檬草精油于汤品或酸味料理增添独特的草本柑橘香气。 居家用 于露台扩香三至四滴柠檬草精油享受户外的清香。 于抹布滴数滴柠檬草精油清洁桌面、流理台等各式表面。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Lemongrass is a tall perennial plant with a subtle citrus flavour, commonly used in Asian cuisine to accent soups, teas, curries, meats, and seafood. Lemongrass oil is often used in skin care products for its cleansing benefits. Its herbaceous aroma helps promote focus and is also well suited to massage therapy. Diffuse Lemongrass or combine it with Fractionated Coconut Oil during a relaxing massage for a fresh, uplifting aroma.
products.claims_en: When diluted, cleanses nail beds for healthy-looking nails. When diluted, provides a refreshing sensation to the skin. Diluted with a carrier oil, releases a relaxing, uplifting aroma during massage. Add to recipes for an herbaceous, citrusy, bittersweet flavour. Pleasant herbaceous aroma.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Add one to two drops of Lemongrass to your daily facial cleanser to promote clean skin. Apply one to two drops of Lemongrass with one to two drops of Melaleuca to toenails to keep them looking clean and healthy. After exercise, dilute one drop of Lemongrass with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil and apply for a refreshing feeling. Apply one drop of Lemongrass with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil to the skin for a soothing massage. Food: Add one to two drops of Lemongrass to soups or sour dishes for a distinctive herbaceous, citrus note. Home: Diffuse three to four drops of Lemongrass on the patio to enjoy a fresh outdoor scent. Add a few drops to a cloth to clean tables, countertops, and other surfaces.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Dilute for topical use; cleanses surfaces
products.desc_en: Why should I add Lemongrass to my collection? Lemongrass oil's chemical constituents include geranial and neral, both members of the aldehyde family. Aldehydes are generally known for their strong, distinctive scent, which is why Lemongrass has a fresh, citrusy, herbaceous aroma. Aldehydes also have surface-cleansing properties, making Lemongrass ideal for cleansing the skin and commonly used surfaces.

products.claims_zh: 于食谱或烘焙食谱中添加以享香甜、辛辣的味道 用基底油稀释，为皮肤提供温暖感 按摩时过程，提供令人舒畅的香氛 增强自制清洁剂的清洁效能。
products.skin: 稀释后局部使用 具有温暖、辛辣、肉桂类的香氛
products.intro_zh: 温暖舒适   桂皮精油 桂皮是肉桂的近亲，数千年来因其温暖宜人的香气和舒缓的芳香功效而备受赞誉。桂皮精油温暖的外用特性和甜美辛香的香气，是秋、冬季的理想选择。您可以在家中扩香，或在调制精油扩香配方时滴入几滴。 桂皮亦可用于料理，例如取代派或面包中的肉桂，或者直接加于各式各样的前菜与甜点，增强您最喜爱的芳香。因为它是一种特别强效的精油，所以涂抹桂皮时必须用基底油稀释。当稀释并外用涂抹时，桂皮会为皮肤带来温暖和舒缓的感觉。桂皮精油还含有高浓度的肉桂醛，具有强效的表面清洁功能，可以为家用清洁喷雾提供额外的清洁效果。
products.tips_zh: 冬季时扩香桂皮精油散发节日的气息。 以一滴桂皮精油搭配基底油按摩享受温热的功效。 煮食时用一滴桂皮精油取替肉桂粉或增强肉桂风味。 将三滴滴入装有水的喷雾瓶中，然后喷洒，为您的家增添香味并清洁坚硬的表面。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服: 取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a warm, spicy, cinnamon-like aroma Adds a sweet, spiced flavour in cooking and baking Provides a warming sensation to the skin when diluted with a carrier oil Boosts cleansing properties of homemade cleaners
products.intro_en: Warm and Comforting — Cassia Oil. A close relative of cinnamon, Cassia has been prized for thousands of years for its warm, inviting aroma and soothing aromatic benefits. With its warming topical properties and sweet, spicy aroma, Cassia is ideal for autumn and winter. Diffuse it at home, or add a few drops to your diffuser blends. Cassia can also be used in cooking—for example, in place of cinnamon in pies or bread, or added to a variety of appetizers and desserts to enhance your favourite flavours. Because it is an especially potent oil, Cassia must be diluted with a carrier oil when applied topically. When diluted and applied topically, Cassia provides a warm, soothing sensation to the skin. Cassia is also high in cinnamaldehyde, which has powerful surface-cleansing properties and can give homemade cleaning sprays an extra boost.
products.claims_en: Add to recipes or baked goods for a sweet, spicy flavour. Dilute with a carrier oil to provide a warming sensation to the skin. Provides a comforting aroma during massage. Boosts the cleaning power of homemade cleaners.
products.tips_en: Diffuse Cassia in winter for a festive feeling. Combine one drop of Cassia with a carrier oil for a warming massage. Use one drop of Cassia in place of ground cinnamon, or to enhance cinnamon flavour, when cooking. Add three drops to a spray bottle with water and mist to scent your home and clean hard surfaces.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Dilute for topical use

products.claims_zh: 散发刺激、清爽的香氛 提供舒缓的按摩。 维持健康的肤况。
products.origin: 纯粹植根于传统   桦木精油 桦木精油来自白桦树的树皮—白桦树也被称为黑桦树、樱桃桦树或甜桦树。
products.intro_zh: 纯粹植根于传统   桦木精油 桦木精油来自白桦树的树皮—白桦树也被称为黑桦树、樱桃桦树或甜桦树。桦木精油具有强烈清爽的薄荷香氛，扩香时可营造刺激、清晰的环境。外用有助保持健康的肤色，或在按摩时产生凉爽、舒缓的感觉。 寻找纯净、无杂质的桦木精油非常具挑选，而且历史上只有少量供应。经过长期努力的觅寻，doTERRA 与宾夕法尼亚州一个拥有悠久可持续生产纯桦木精油传统的家族合作，从而确保了 100% 专业纯正检测认证的纯桦木精油的永续可靠来源。
products.tips_zh: 运动后按摩背部和腿部以获得凉爽的感觉。 涂抹于皮肤上，有助促进皮肤健康的外观。 滴几滴在棉球，然后放在健身包中，即可获得清新的香氛。
products.directions_zh: 扩香： 在芳香喷雾器中加入三至四滴进行扩香。 外用：于所需部位涂抹一至两滴。用基础油稀释以减少肌肤敏感。详情请参阅以下注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。放置处应远离孩童。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

products.intro_en: Pure and Rooted in Tradition — Birch Oil. Birch oil comes from the bark of the birch tree, also known as black birch, cherry birch, or sweet birch. Birch has a strong, refreshing, minty aroma that creates a stimulating, clear environment when diffused. Applied topically, it helps maintain a healthy-looking complexion and provides a cooling, soothing sensation during massage. Finding pure, unadulterated Birch oil is very challenging, and historically it has only been available in small quantities. After a long search, doTERRA partnered with a Pennsylvania family with a long tradition of sustainably producing pure Birch oil, securing a sustainable, reliable source of 100% CPTG Certified Pure Tested Grade Birch oil.
products.claims_en: Releases a stimulating, refreshing aroma. Provides a soothing massage. Maintains healthy-looking skin.
products.tips_en: Massage onto the back and legs after exercise for a cooling sensation. Apply to the skin to help promote a healthy-looking appearance. Place a few drops on a cotton ball and put it in your gym bag for a fresh aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Birch oil comes from the bark of the birch tree, also known as black birch, cherry birch, or sweet birch.

products.origin: 辛辣、香料、舒适   生姜精油 采购自马达加斯加，doTERRA 的生姜精油萃取于新鲜的生姜根茎—也就是植物位于地底下布满根系的茎部。
products.intro_zh: 辛辣、香料、舒适   生姜精油 采购自马达加斯加，doTERRA 的生姜精油萃取于新鲜的生姜根茎—也就是植物位于地底下布满根系的茎部。 生姜是许多亚洲菜谱中的明星成分，最常用作厨房香料。在西方传统烹饪中，生姜最常用于草木茶、姜饼和黄姜圆脆饼。生姜精油具有辛辣、芳香的风味，可增强食谱中新鲜生姜的味道，并为在家泡茶时增添温暖、甜美的味道。扩香生姜精油还会产生令人舒适、舒缓的香氛，亦可为个人按摩体验增添温暖。
products.tips_zh: 坐长途车时，从手掌或瓶子深吸。 饭后涂抹于下腹部进行舒缓按摩。 泡澡时滴入一滴营造舒缓芳香的体验。 于热水中加入蜂蜜并滴一滴生姜精油，制成舒缓的草本茶。 在甜和咸食谱中使用一滴以增强新鲜生姜的风味。 扩香享受舒适、提振的香氛。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在4盎司液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

products.intro_en: Spicy, Aromatic, Comforting — Ginger Oil. Sourced from Madagascar, doTERRA Ginger oil is extracted from fresh ginger rhizomes—the underground stem of the plant from which its roots grow. Ginger is a star ingredient in many Asian recipes and is most commonly used as a kitchen spice. In traditional Western cooking, ginger is most often used in herbal teas, gingerbread, and gingersnaps. With its spicy, aromatic flavour, Ginger oil enhances the taste of fresh ginger in recipes and adds a warm, sweet note to homemade tea. Diffused, Ginger creates a comforting, soothing aroma, and it can also add warmth to a personal massage experience.
products.claims_en: Provides a soothing aroma during massage. Soothing, warming, energizing aroma. Add to water or recipes for a spicy, earthy flavour.
products.tips_en: Inhale deeply from your palms or the bottle during long car rides. Apply to the lower abdomen for a soothing massage after meals. Add one drop to a bath for a soothing aromatic experience. Add honey and one drop of Ginger to hot water for a soothing herbal tea. Use one drop in sweet and savoury recipes to enhance fresh ginger flavour. Diffuse for a comforting, uplifting aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.

products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把百里香精油纳入收藏? 百里香精油具有与其他草本精油一般的草本香气和表面清洁功效，而百里香精油特别应用于个人保健和个人卫生。百里香具有类似于牛至精油能为食物和饮料增添风味。

products.claims_en: Freshens breath. Provides an invigorating aroma during massage. When diluted and applied to targeted areas, helps cleanse the skin. Add to recipes for an herbaceous flavour. Cleanses surfaces.

Dilute one drop of Thyme with 10 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil and apply to desired area to cleanse skin or nails. Food: Add two to three drops of Thyme to marinades for extra flavour. products.intro_en: Minty Fresh — Spearmint Oil. Spearmint is a familiar herb whose fresh, minty flavour and breath-freshening properties make it widely used in chewing gum and dental care products. doTERRA Spearmint oil is not only suited to oral care and cooking, but also delivers a powerfully refreshing aroma. Applied topically, it provides a cooling, invigorating sensation to the skin for a refreshed feeling. Spearmint has a milder scent than other mint oils, making it a relatively suitable topical option for those with sensitive skin. Its fresh aroma is uplifting and motivating—diffuse it while working or studying. In the kitchen, Spearmint is commonly used in salads, beverages, and desserts, and can also be added to homemade salad dressings or meat marinades for a natural touch of freshness.
products.claims_en: Fresh, refreshing, uplifting aroma. Add to beverages and recipes for a minty flavour. Helps cleanse teeth and provides a distinctive flavour.
products.tips_en: Diffuse Spearmint for a positive aroma. Use one drop of Spearmint in a massage for a cooling sensation. Apply Spearmint to your toothbrush before brushing. Add one to two drops of Spearmint to water and gargle to freshen breath. Add one or two drops of Spearmint to desserts, beverages, salads, or entrées for extra flavour.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Dilute before applying to sensitive skin

products.claims_zh: 具有温暖，辛辣，草本的香气 于水或食谱中添加以享清甜，草本风味 为肌肤带来舒缓的感觉
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.intro_zh: 罗勒精油有比罗勒叶更强的舒缓和甜美的香气，罗勒精油有广泛的用途，包括芳香疗法，局部涂抹以及烹饪过程中可替代新鲜罗勒。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把罗勒精油纳入收藏? 像许多其他嫩叶草本精油（例如胡荽叶精油）一样，罗勒精油含有大量的芳樟醇，这种成分有助舒缓皮肤。然而，罗勒精油的香气特别令人振奋且放松，其独特优势在芳香疗法中高于其他含有芳樟醇的精油。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 天气温热时可涂抹于肌肤带来沁凉功效。 读书或阅读时可涂抹于颈部后方散发充满能量的香气。 搭配分馏椰子油涂抹于腹部进行舒缓按摩。 取一滴罗勒精油和一滴茶树精油再搭配分馏椰子油涂抹于颈部及耳后舒缓肌肤。 食用 以橄榄油搭配罗勒精油自制义式面包沾酱。 居家用 搭配莱姆、佛手柑或薄荷扩香使用散发活络香气。 读书、阅读或拟订计划时扩香以享放松香气。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a warm, spicy, herbal aroma Adds a refreshing, herbal flavor to water and recipes Provides a soothing sensation to skin
products.intro_en: Basil oil has a more soothing, sweeter aroma than basil leaves. It has a wide range of uses, including aromatherapy and topical application, and can replace fresh basil in cooking.
products.claims_en: Warm, spicy, herbaceous aroma. Add to water or recipes for a sweet, herbaceous flavour. Provides a soothing sensation to the skin.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Apply to the skin in warm weather for a cooling effect. Apply to the back of the neck while studying or reading for an energizing aroma. Apply with Fractionated Coconut Oil to the abdomen for a soothing massage. Combine one drop of Basil and one drop of Melaleuca with Fractionated Coconut Oil and apply to the neck and behind the ears to soothe the skin. Food: Combine Basil with olive oil for a homemade Italian bread dip. Home: Diffuse with Lime, Bergamot, or Peppermint for an invigorating aroma. Diffuse while studying, reading, or planning for a relaxing aroma.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)
products.desc_en: Why should I add Basil to my collection? Like many other leafy herb oils (such as Cilantro), Basil is high in linalool, a constituent that helps soothe the skin. However, Basil's aroma is especially uplifting and relaxing, giving it a unique advantage in aromatherapy over other linalool-containing oils.

products.claims_zh: 提供甜美、温暖、舒适的香氛与基底油稀释使用，为皮肤提供温暖的感觉于水或食谱中添加温暖、五香的风味清新口气清洁表面
products.skin: 稀释后局部使用
products.constituents: 反式肉桂醛、乙酸肉桂酯、丁香油酚
products.intro_zh: 肉桂精油是从芳香的肉桂树皮蒸馏而成，它以熟悉的香氛和多功能而闻名。只需一滴这款明星精油就能温暖您的心和您的家。
products.desc_zh: 肉桂是所有精油中最具辨识度和最受欢迎的香味之一，它具有广泛的芳香、外用和烹饪用途。简单的扩香肉桂精油，温暖的香氛将充满您的空间，您的家就成为一个舒适的港湾。肉桂精油具有强大的清洁功效，可以优化您的家居清洁程序。它具有口腔护理的功效，是漱口水和口香糖中的常见成分。肉桂精油的经典风味也可用于替代或增强您最喜欢的食谱、烘焙食品和热饮中肉桂粉的味道。 *肉桂是一款强效精油，涂抹在皮肤时应使用基底油稀释。
products.tips_zh: 将一滴加入少量水中漱口使用。 按摩时用基底油稀释肉桂精油，为皮肤带来温暖的感觉。 冬季时，添加在茶或蜂蜜中，即可成为一杯浓浓暖意且充满五香风味的饮料。 在寒冷的季节扩香肉桂精油，享受令人振奋的香氛。 于载有水的喷雾瓶中滴入2-3滴，快速变身为清洁喷雾。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服：取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Provides a sweet, warm, comforting aroma Provides a warming sensation to skin when combined with a carrier oil Adds a warm, spiced flavour to water and recipes Freshens breath Cleanses surfaces
products.intro_en: Steam distilled from aromatic cinnamon bark, Cinnamon Bark oil is known for its familiar aroma and versatility. Just one drop of this star oil can warm your heart and your home.
products.claims_en: Sweet, warm, comforting aroma. Dilute with a carrier oil to provide a warming sensation to the skin. Add to water or recipes for a warm, spicy flavour. Freshens breath. Cleanses surfaces.
products.tips_en: Add one drop to a small amount of water and use as a mouth rinse. Dilute Cinnamon Bark with a carrier oil during massage for a warming sensation on the skin. In winter, add to tea or honey for a warm, richly spiced beverage. Diffuse Cinnamon Bark in the colder months for an uplifting aroma. Add 2–3 drops to a spray bottle filled with water for a quick cleaning spray.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.aroma_en: Spicy, woody, warm and sweet, lingering
products.skin_en: Dilute for topical use
products.desc_en: Cinnamon is one of the most recognizable and beloved scents of all essential oils, with a wide range of aromatic, topical, and culinary uses. Simply diffuse Cinnamon Bark and its warm aroma will fill your space, turning your home into a cozy haven. With its powerful cleansing properties, Cinnamon Bark can enhance your household cleaning routine. It also offers oral care benefits and is a common ingredient in mouthwash and chewing gum. Cinnamon Bark's classic flavour can also replace or enhance ground cinnamon in your favourite recipes, baked goods, and hot drinks. Cinnamon Bark is a potent oil and should be diluted with a carrier oil when applied to the skin.

products.claims_zh: 于水或食谱中添加以享清新，草本风味 可以帮助清洁皮肤 促进肤色透亮感 为肌肤带来舒缓的感觉
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.constituents: 芳樟醇、α-蒎烯、γ-松油烯、樟脑
products.intro_zh: 胡荽精油萃取自胡荽植物的种子。它的香气类似新鲜草本香，但具有独特的益处。胡荽精油的舒缓香气有助于营造轻松的氛围，除扩香外，还可局部涂抹于皮肤以达到清洁目的，用于煮食时获得明亮的味道。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把胡荽精油纳入收藏? 胡荽精油的化学成分与薰衣草精油类似都含有大量的芳樟醇。芳樟醇的含量使胡荽精油成为对皮肤最好的精油之一，帮助皮肤保持清洁，展现透亮肤色。这是香料精油家族中一个非常独特的特征，胡荽精油的明亮，近似柑橘的气味使其成为偏爱土质香护肤品用家的宠儿。像薰衣草精油一样，胡荽精油也提供了特别舒缓的香气。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 滴一滴胡荽精油于洁面产品一同使用促进干净的肌肤。 忙碌的一天后涂抹两滴胡荽精油于颈部后方或足底。 短暂的运动后可于腿部涂抹数滴胡荽精油散发舒缓香气进行按摩。 使用体香膏前可先涂抹两滴胡荽精油于腋下散发干净，明亮的香气。 以三至四滴胡荽精油搭配分馏椰子油涂抹肌肤在舒缓按摩过程散发放松的香气。 食用 于咖哩食谱中滴入一滴胡荽精油增添风味。 居家用 以两滴胡荽精油搭配薄荷精油扩香以享提振香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服：取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Coriander oil is extracted from the seeds of the coriander plant. Its aroma resembles that of fresh herbs, yet it offers its own unique benefits. Coriander's soothing aroma helps create a relaxed atmosphere; besides diffusing, it can be applied topically to cleanse the skin or used in cooking for a bright flavour.
products.claims_en: Add to water or recipes for a fresh, herbaceous flavour. Can help cleanse the skin. Promotes a clear-looking complexion. Provides a soothing sensation to the skin.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Add one drop of Coriander to your facial cleanser to promote clean skin. Apply two drops of Coriander to the back of the neck or soles of the feet after a busy day. After a short workout, apply a few drops to the legs and massage for a soothing aroma. Apply two drops of Coriander to the underarms before deodorant for a clean, bright scent. Combine three to four drops of Coriander with Fractionated Coconut Oil and apply to the skin for a relaxing aroma during a soothing massage. Food: Add one drop of Coriander to curry recipes for extra flavour. Home: Diffuse two drops of Coriander with Peppermint for an uplifting aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)
products.desc_en: Why should I add Coriander to my collection? Like Lavender, Coriander oil is high in linalool. This linalool content makes Coriander one of the best oils for the skin, helping keep it clean and promoting a clear-looking complexion. This is a very unique trait within the spice oil family, and Coriander's bright, almost citrusy scent makes it a favourite of those who prefer earthy-scented skin care. Like Lavender, Coriander also offers an especially soothing aroma.

products.claims_zh: 具有舒适和鼓舞人心的香气 营造提升和激励人心的环境 促进皮肤外观健康
products.skin: 可先稀释后用于易敏感肌肤
products.aroma: 香甜，花香，温暖，异域风情
products.origin: 经过数十年的研究，终于，doTERRA一位主要的埃及采购伙伴发现了一种方法能成功用蒸汽蒸馏法提取并小量生产茉莉的纯精油。
products.intro_zh: 与众不同、纯白色的茉莉花令人视觉著迷，备受世界各地的人所珍视，它亦象征爱情与浪漫。茉莉因其有层次且迷人的甜美花香及新鲜香气被称为“花中之王”。茉莉既可爱又芬芳，同时也非常精致。一直以来，萃取精油的过程为原精法，因为茉莉花花瓣太过精致，蒸汽蒸馏法从未萃取成功。经过数十年的研究，终于，doTERRA一位主要的埃及采购伙伴发现了一种方法能成功用蒸汽蒸馏法提取并小量生产茉莉的纯精油。因此，doTERRA荣幸地拥有这独家的机会，展示世界第一批蒸汽蒸馏而来的茉莉精油。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把茉莉精油纳入收藏? doTERRA的独家产品，您可以享受细致、蒸汽蒸馏以成的茉莉精油的香气和好处。茉莉精油具有镇定的香氛和温和的保湿功效，添加茉莉精油到护肤品或头发护理产品有效促进健康的外观及焕发肤色。扩香茉莉以营造开朗的氛围并辅助冥想时段。当与基底油混和使用时，可以成为放松的淋浴时间或舒缓按摩的一部分。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 将茉莉精油与基底油稀释，然后加到温水浴中。 将茉莉精油与分馏椰子油混合进行充满放松香气的按摩。 局部涂抹茉莉精油或添加到保养品或头发护理产品中。 家居扩香茉莉精油散发宁静的香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a comforting and encouraging aromaCreates an elevating and inspiring environmentPromotes healthy-looking skin
products.intro_en: Distinctive white jasmine flowers are visually captivating and treasured by people around the world as a symbol of love and romance. Jasmine is called the "King of Flowers" for its layered, alluring, sweet floral and fresh fragrance. Lovely and fragrant, jasmine is also very delicate. Its oil has traditionally been extracted as an absolute, because the petals were too delicate for steam distillation ever to succeed. After decades of research, one of doTERRA's key sourcing partners in Egypt finally discovered a way to successfully steam distill pure Jasmine oil in small quantities. As a result, doTERRA has the exclusive honour of offering the world's first steam-distilled Jasmine oil.
products.claims_en: Comforting, inspiring aroma. Creates an uplifting, motivating environment. Promotes healthy-looking skin.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Dilute Jasmine with a carrier oil and add to a warm bath. Combine Jasmine with Fractionated Coconut Oil for a massage with a relaxing aroma. Apply Jasmine topically or add it to skin care or hair care products. Diffuse Jasmine at home for a peaceful aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: After decades of research, one of doTERRA's key sourcing partners in Egypt finally discovered a way to successfully steam distill pure Jasmine oil in small quantities.
products.skin_en: Dilute before applying to sensitive skin
products.desc_en: Why should I add Jasmine to my collection? Exclusive to doTERRA, you can enjoy the aroma and benefits of delicate, steam-distilled Jasmine oil. Jasmine has a calming aroma and gentle moisturizing benefits; adding it to skin care or hair care products helps promote a healthy, radiant appearance. Diffuse Jasmine to create a cheerful atmosphere and support your meditation time. Combined with a carrier oil, it can become part of a relaxing shower or soothing massage.

products.tips_zh: 保养用 扩香可为任何房间营造温暖、柔和的氛围。 于您最喜爱的保湿霜或洁面乳添加一滴蓝艾菊精油，以舒缓肌肤。 在润肤液中加入一到两滴用于按摩。 滴二至三滴于棉花球再置于车内出风口享受舒缓香气。

products.intro_en: Blue Tansy oil is named for its vivid blue colour. A key ingredient in doTERRA Deep Blue and Balance blends, Blue Tansy delivers powerful benefits through its aroma and targeted topical application.
products.claims_en: Fruity, rich, refreshing aroma. Provides a cooling sensation to the skin. Offers a calming, relaxing aroma during massage. Soothes dry skin. Promotes a youthful, radiant-looking complexion.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Diffuse to create a warm, mellow atmosphere in any room. Add one drop of Blue Tansy to your favourite moisturizer or cleanser to soothe the skin. Add one to two drops to lotion for massage. Place two to three drops on a cotton ball and put it in your car's air vent for a soothing aroma.

products.desc_en: Blue Tansy—also known as Moroccan tansy—is an annual, yellow-flowered Mediterranean plant native to northern Morocco. It is a prized ingredient in high-end skin care products.

products.claims_zh: 具有木质、清新、活力香氛创造一个宁静、正向的空间扩香可享令人放松的香氛用于帮助增强舒缓按摩的效果

products.intro_zh: 漫步林间   西伯利亚冷杉精油 西伯利亚冷杉精油采用蒸气蒸馏法，萃取自生长于西伯利亚偏远森林的常绿树木。它散发著清新、木质的香气，能将森林的宁静带入您的家中，并在扩香后营造一个宁静、积极的空间。西伯利亚冷杉精油富含萜烯乙酸龙脑酯和α-蒎烯，这两种成分都与森林浴的放松和焕活功效有密切关系。 除了芳香功效外，西伯利亚冷杉还能舒缓肌肤。使用这款精油，可为舒适的肩部按摩增添活力，或在日常护肤品中滴入一滴，带来焕发活力的功效，并增强清洁功效。
products.tips_zh: 运动后按摩腿部和肩部。 滴在淋浴地板上，享受活力蒸气体验。 滴一滴在日常保湿霜中，提升肌肤健康光泽。 将精油加入喷雾瓶中，加水后用于家中香氛和清洁坚硬表面。 在家中扩香，感受宁静、集中的香氛。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

products.intro_en: A Walk in the Woods — Siberian Fir Oil. Siberian Fir oil is steam distilled from evergreen trees growing in the remote forests of Siberia. Its fresh, woody aroma brings the tranquility of the forest into your home and, when diffused, creates a peaceful, positive space. Siberian Fir is rich in the terpenes bornyl acetate and α-pinene, both closely associated with the relaxing and revitalizing benefits of forest bathing. Beyond its aromatic benefits, Siberian Fir also soothes the skin. Use it to add energy to a comforting shoulder massage, or add a drop to your daily skin care for a revitalizing effect and enhanced cleansing.
products.claims_en: Woody, fresh, energizing aroma. Creates a peaceful, positive space. Diffuse to enjoy a relaxing aroma. Used to help enhance a soothing massage.
products.tips_en: Massage into legs and shoulders after exercise. Place on the shower floor for an energizing steam experience. Add one drop to your daily moisturizer for a healthy-looking glow. Add to a spray bottle with water to scent your home and clean hard surfaces. Diffuse at home for a peaceful, focused aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Siberian Fir oil is steam distilled from evergreen trees growing in the remote forests of Siberia.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)

products.tips_zh: 保养用 将西班牙鼠尾草精油与基底油或乳霜混合使用，以享放松的按摩。 在考试或简报会前，将西班牙鼠尾草精油涂抹在手腕或颈部，以获得令人振奋的香氛。 居家用 将精油添加到您选择芳香喷雾器中，在学习时营造激励的氛围。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。

CPTG® Certified Pure Tested Grade Spanish Sage has camphoraceous, herbaceous, sage-like notes and effectively creates an uplifting atmosphere when diffused. Used in massage, this camphor-rich oil leaves the skin feeling energized and comfortable.

products.intro_zh: 厨房常见的香料种子，豆蔻精油经常被用于食品和饮料调味，并具有镇静和放松的香气。豆蔻精油对皮肤也有提振作用，局部涂抹时散发独特的清凉感。 豆蔻精油通过doTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®互相效力合作计划从瓜地马拉采购。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把豆蔻精油纳入收藏? 像所有香料精油一样，豆蔻精油因标志的风味和香气常用于烹饪。然而，豆蔻精油因含有大量1,8-桉叶素在香料精油中独一无二，涂抹于皮肤上有著极强的清香和清凉效果。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 以分馏椰子油稀释两滴豆蔻精油进行活络按摩，为皮肤带来凉爽感觉。 涂抹一滴豆蔻精油于胸口再深吸其充满能量的香气。 泡澡时滴入一滴豆蔻精油，以增强放松的沐浴时光。 食用 于手工巧克力滴入一滴豆蔻精油增添独特辛辣风味。 于面包、肉食料理和沙拉滴入一至两滴豆蔻精油提升味觉层次。 居家用 以两滴豆蔻精油搭配三滴薰衣草精油扩香以享舒缓香气。 扩香三至四滴豆蔻精油享受清爽、清新的香气，营造明亮气氛。 冥想时，滴一滴豆蔻精油于手掌深吸和谐的香气营造专注环境。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服: 取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。

products.intro_en: A spice seed common in the kitchen, Cardamom is often used to flavour food and beverages and has a calming, relaxing aroma. Cardamom is also uplifting for the skin, providing a distinctive cooling sensation when applied topically. Cardamom oil is sourced from Guatemala through doTERRA's Co-Impact Sourcing® initiative.
products.claims_en: Spicy, fruity, warm, energizing aroma. Add to water or recipes for a spicy, enhanced flavour. Provides a soothing sensation to the skin. Offers a harmonizing, calming aroma during massage.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Dilute two drops of Cardamom with Fractionated Coconut Oil for an invigorating massage that brings a cooling sensation to the skin. Apply one drop of Cardamom to the chest and inhale its energizing aroma deeply. Add one drop of Cardamom to a bath to enhance a relaxing soak. Food: Add one drop of Cardamom to homemade chocolate for a distinctive spicy flavour. Add one to two drops to breads, meat dishes, and salads to elevate their flavour. Home: Diffuse two drops of Cardamom with three drops of Lavender for a soothing aroma. Diffuse three to four drops of Cardamom for a crisp, fresh aroma and bright atmosphere. During meditation, place one drop of Cardamom in your palms and inhale its harmonizing aroma deeply to create a focused environment.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.aroma_en: Spicy, rich and fruity, warm, balsamic
products.origin_en: Cardamom oil is sourced from Guatemala through doTERRA's Co-Impact Sourcing® initiative.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)
products.desc_en: Why should I add Cardamom to my collection? Like all spice oils, Cardamom is commonly used in cooking for its signature flavour and aroma. However, Cardamom is unique among spice oils because it is high in 1,8-cineole, giving it a remarkably fresh aroma and cooling effect when applied to the skin.

products.intro_zh: 雪松精油萃取自东方红杉树的心材并以蒸汽蒸馏法制成，该款精油是所有木质调精油中用途最广之一。当外用涂抹或芳香使用时，雪松精油的静谧、镇静特性有助促进放松的氛围。
products.desc_zh: 雪松精油具有温暖的木质调香气，扩香使用有助为任何空间迎来清新的森林香氛，抑或是为复方精油的配方注入一丝镇静气息。雪松是香水、古龙水以及身体呵护产品中的常见成分，它能为肌肤带来绝佳的功效，同时亦在肌肤保养程序中扮演要角。就寝前，将一滴雪松精油按摩于足底，有助营造平和的助眠氛围。
products.tips_zh: 将一滴精油加入爽肤水中，有助促进洁净、健康的肤况。 将一至两滴雪松精油加入热水浴以享放松气息。 扩香使用三至四滴雪松精油，有助营造放松的氛围。 将一滴精油滴于棉花球，放置于衣柜或抽屉以使衣物保持清新气息。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

products.intro_en: Steam distilled from the heartwood of the eastern red cedar, Cedarwood is one of the most versatile of all woody oils. When applied topically or used aromatically, Cedarwood's tranquil, calming properties help promote a relaxing atmosphere.
products.claims_en: Creates a comforting, relaxing atmosphere. Helps maintain healthy-looking skin. Promotes a radiant complexion. Fills your home with a pleasant aroma.
products.tips_en: Add one drop to your toner to help promote clean, healthy-looking skin. Add one to two drops of Cedarwood to a hot bath for a relaxing experience. Diffuse three to four drops of Cedarwood to help create a relaxing atmosphere. Place one drop on a cotton ball and put it in your closet or drawers to keep clothes smelling fresh.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

products.desc_en: Cedarwood has a warm, woody aroma; diffuse it to bring a fresh forest scent to any space, or add a calming touch to your diffuser blends. Cedarwood is a common ingredient in perfumes, colognes, and body care products; it offers excellent benefits for the skin and plays a key role in skin care routines. Before bed, massage one drop of Cedarwood into the soles of your feet to help create a peaceful, restful atmosphere.

products.constituents: 萜品烯-4-醇、水合桧烯、γ-松油烯
products.intro_zh: 称为「冬之香甜」或「山之喜悦」的马郁兰对希腊人和罗马人而言是快乐的象征。在德国因做为烤鹅肉的传统香料又称为「鹅草」。马郁兰精油萃取自叶子，具有浓郁、草本风味，用于料理中赋予汤品、炖菜、调料与沾酱温暖独特的风味。今日，马郁兰精油则以其在舒缓按摩期间或运动后扩香所散发的镇静香气而备受重视。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把马郁兰精油纳入收藏? 马郁兰精油有著高浓度的化学成分萜品烯-4-醇，按摩使用具有舒缓的效用。它还具有强大的局部清洁功效。睡前扩香马郁兰精油营造轻松的环境，或将其轻轻涂抹在颈后和肩部，让清新、镇静的香气在一天快完结时绕梁。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 睡前于脚底涂抹一至两滴马郁兰精油以享镇静香气。 涂抹一至两滴马郁兰精油于颈部后方和肩膀享受放松香气。 运动后以5滴分馏椰子油稀释一滴马郁兰精油涂抹带来舒缓感。 食用 以马郁兰精油取代食谱中的马郁兰配料，以获得美味的草本味道。 于橄榄油注入两至三滴马郁兰精油使用制作清爽的沙拉酱、腌酱或面包沾酱。 居家用 扩香两至三滴马郁兰精油、雪松精油和薰衣草精油散发放松帮助睡眠的香气。 于水中滴入几滴马郁兰精油和薰衣草精油。喷洒床单或寝具散发助眠香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Called "winter sweet" and "joy of the mountains," marjoram was a symbol of happiness to the Greeks and Romans. In Germany, it is also known as the "goose herb" for its traditional use in seasoning roast goose. Extracted from the leaves, Marjoram oil has a rich, herbaceous flavour that gives soups, stews, dressings, and sauces a warm, distinctive taste. Today, Marjoram is valued for the calming aroma it releases during a soothing massage or when diffused after exercise.
products.claims_en: Calming, relaxing, gentle aroma. Provides a sweet aroma during massage. Add to recipes for a warm, herbaceous flavour.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Apply one to two drops of Marjoram to the soles of the feet before bed for a calming aroma. Apply one to two drops to the back of the neck and shoulders for a relaxing aroma. After exercise, dilute one drop of Marjoram with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil and apply for a soothing sensation. Food: Replace dried marjoram in recipes with Marjoram oil for a delicious herbaceous flavour. Infuse olive oil with two to three drops of Marjoram for a fresh salad dressing, marinade, or bread dip. Home: Diffuse two to three drops each of Marjoram, Cedarwood, and Lavender for a relaxing aroma that supports sleep. Add a few drops of Marjoram and Lavender to water and spritz on sheets or bedding for a restful aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be applied neat (no dilution needed)
products.desc_en: Why should I add Marjoram to my collection? Marjoram is high in the chemical constituent terpinen-4-ol, which has a soothing effect when used in massage. It also has powerful topical cleansing benefits. Diffuse Marjoram before bed to create a relaxing environment, or gently apply it to the back of the neck and shoulders to let its fresh, calming aroma linger as the day winds down.

products.claims_zh: 提供镇定、放松的香氛营造干净、透气的居家环境按摩时提供舒缓的感觉有助清洁和舒缓肌肤

products.origin: 清新松针的香氛   黑云杉精油 来自加拿大壮丽北方针叶林、以永续方式采集的黑云杉精油，能将宁静户外的气息带入您的生活空间，为居家环境注入令人振奋的香氛。 采购黑云杉: 黑云杉精油来自加拿大 Chapais，并透过 Co-Impact Sourcing 互相效力合作计划采购。 我们的采购合作伙伴使用先进的零废弃物设施，将木材产业多余的原料转化为可持续采购的美丽精油。
products.intro_zh: 清新松针的香氛   黑云杉精油 来自加拿大壮丽北方针叶林、以永续方式采集的黑云杉精油，能将宁静户外的气息带入您的生活空间，为居家环境注入令人振奋的香氛。 黑云杉是一款强效木质类精油，采自云杉树 (Picea mariana) 的针叶与枝条，以蒸气蒸馏法萃取而成。黑云杉含有高浓度的乙酸冰片酯化学成分，有助营造平静放松的氛围。可在一天中扩香，或涂抹于后颈，享受放松氛围与清新可呼吸的香气。黑云杉外用时也能带来清凉舒缓的感受。搭配基底油稀释后按摩于肌肤，或用于疲惫的肩膀与腿部，带来舒适的按摩体验。 采购黑云杉: 黑云杉精油来自加拿大 Chapais，并透过 Co-Impact Sourcing 互相效力合作计划采购。我们的采购合作伙伴使用先进的零废弃物设施，将木材产业多余的原料转化为可持续采购的美丽精油。
products.tips_zh: 搭配基底油按摩于肌肤，享受舒缓的按摩体验。 在日常保养中加入一滴，有助促进洁净、平衡的肤况。 涂抹于胸前，或于一天中吸闻，享受清凉且振奋的香气。 在居家空间中扩香，营造平静放松的氛围。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。请参看下方的注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。放置处应远离孩童。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Provides a calming, relaxing aroma Promotes a clear, breathable home environment Provides a soothing sensation during massage Can help clean and comfort the skin
products.intro_en: The Scent of Fresh Pine Needles — Black Spruce Oil. Sustainably harvested from Canada's majestic boreal forest, Black Spruce oil brings the tranquility of the outdoors into your living space and fills your home with an uplifting aroma. Black Spruce is a powerful woody oil steam distilled from the needles and twigs of the spruce tree (Picea mariana). High in the chemical constituent bornyl acetate, Black Spruce helps create a calm, relaxing atmosphere. Diffuse it throughout the day or apply it to the back of the neck to enjoy a relaxing atmosphere and fresh, breathable aroma. Applied topically, Black Spruce also provides a cooling, soothing sensation. Dilute with a carrier oil and massage into the skin, or use on tired shoulders and legs for a comforting massage. Sourcing Black Spruce: Black Spruce oil comes from Chapais, Canada, and is sourced through the Co-Impact Sourcing initiative. Our sourcing partner uses an advanced zero-waste facility that transforms surplus material from the timber industry into a beautiful, sustainably sourced essential oil.
products.claims_en: Provides a calming, relaxing aroma. Creates a clean, breathable home environment. Provides a soothing sensation during massage. Helps cleanse and soothe the skin.
products.tips_en: Massage into the skin with a carrier oil for a soothing massage experience. Add one drop to your daily skin care routine to help promote clean, balanced-looking skin. Apply to the chest, or inhale throughout the day, for a cool, uplifting aroma. Diffuse at home to create a calm, relaxing atmosphere.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Black Spruce oil comes from Chapais, Canada, and is sourced through doTERRA's Co-Impact Sourcing initiative. Our sourcing partner uses an advanced zero-waste facility that transforms surplus material from the timber industry into a beautiful, sustainably sourced essential oil.
products.skin_en: Dilute before applying to sensitive skin
