products.origin: 黑胡椒精油，源自常见的烹饪香料，以其果香的温暖而著称。
products.intro_zh: 黑胡椒精油，源自常见的烹饪香料，以其果香的温暖而著称。黑胡椒精油丰富了黑胡椒籽，在局部使用时可为皮肤提供鲜明刺激的香氛和温热的感觉。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把黑胡椒精油纳入收藏? 像其他香料精油一样，黑胡椒精油在烹饪时能增加菜肴的风味。但是，黑胡椒精油含有柠檬烯—富强大的表面清洁功能。这特显了黑胡椒油在众多香料精油中的多样化，因为它在清洁和芳香调理具双重用途。此外，它的香气特别温暖和提振。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 滴一滴黑胡椒精油于掌心再深呼吸以享充满能量的香气。 在疲惫的足底涂抹一滴黑胡椒精油，以享焕发的香氛及皮肤温热的触感。 以分馏椰子油稀释一滴黑胡椒精油再涂抹于腹部进行按摩提振身心。 食用 添加一至二滴黑胡椒精油于各式巧克力甜点带来独特的风味。 添加一滴黑胡椒精油于各式肉食料理、汤品、前菜和沙拉增添食物的层次感。 居家用 忙碌疲惫的一天中可扩香黑胡椒精油散发活络香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服: 取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a hot, sharp, fruity, spicy aroma Adds a spicy, enhanced flavor to water and recipes Provides a warm, soothing sensation to skin through massage when combined with a carrier oil
products.intro_en: Derived from the common cooking spice, Black Pepper oil is known for its fruity warmth. Capturing the richness of black peppercorns, Black Pepper oil offers a bold, stimulating aroma and provides a warming sensation to the skin when applied topically.
products.claims_en: Warm, spicy, fruity, pungent aroma. Add to water and recipes for a spicy, enhanced flavour. Combine with a carrier oil during massage to provide a warming, soothing sensation to the skin.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Place one drop of Black Pepper in your palm and breathe deeply for an energizing aroma. Apply one drop of Black Pepper to tired feet for a revitalizing aroma and warming sensation on the skin. Dilute one drop of Black Pepper with Fractionated Coconut Oil and massage into the abdomen to uplift body and mind. Food: Add one to two drops of Black Pepper to chocolate desserts for a distinctive flavour. Add one drop of Black Pepper to meat dishes, soups, appetizers, and salads to add depth of flavour. Home: Diffuse Black Pepper during a busy, tiring day for an invigorating aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 120 mL of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Derived from the common cooking spice, Black Pepper oil is known for its fruity warmth.
products.skin_en: Dilute before applying to sensitive skin
products.desc_en: Why should I add Black Pepper to my collection? Like other spice oils, Black Pepper adds flavour to dishes when cooking. However, Black Pepper also contains limonene, which has powerful surface-cleansing properties. This highlights Black Pepper's versatility among spice oils, with dual uses for cleansing and aromatic support. In addition, its aroma is especially warm and uplifting.

products.intro_zh: 广藿香与薄荷属于同科植物以改善肌肤瑕疵的功效著称，同时能舒缓消化不良的症状。天然健康产品编号(NPN)为 80060989。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 涂抹于腋下做为天然的体香剂。 搭配日常保湿用品使用促进光亮的肤质。 于洗发乳滴入一滴精油使用按摩头发舒缓干燥的头皮。 疲惫的一天后搭配同量薄荷精油涂抹太阳穴和颈部。 取1/2小匙小苏打、两大匙水、两滴薄荷精油和一滴广藿香精油自制漱口水。 居家用 扩香以享安稳平和的香气。 喷雾瓶加入水再滴入10滴精油于户外活动时喷洒全身散发愉悦香气。 调理级用 用于芳香疗法可安定神经具镇静效果。 用于芳香疗法以舒缓青春痘和脓肿的问题。 用于芳香疗法以减缓轻微肌肤不适、割伤、瘀青和烫伤。 用于芳香疗法减缓胀气与痉挛等消化不良的症状。
products.cautions_zh: 请勿用于口腔。请置于孩童伸手不及处。仅限外用。请勿接触眼睛与黏膜，若不慎进入请以植物油彻底洗净。若不慎误食，请立即联络紧急医疗服务或当地毒药物防治咨询中心。若具有癫痫或气喘病史请先咨询医师，若使用后症状加重也请联络医师。怀孕或哺乳者请勿使用本产品。涂抹区域于24小时至48小时内请勿接触阳光。倘若出现恶心、晕眩、头痛或其他过敏症状，请停止使用。欲长期使用请先咨询医疗专业。
products.intro_en: A member of the mint family, Patchouli is known for reducing the appearance of skin imperfections and can also help relieve symptoms of digestive discomfort. Natural Product Number (NPN) 80060989.
products.claims_en: Used in aromatherapy as a sedative and calmative.
products.tips_en: Personal care: Apply to the underarms as a natural deodorant. Use with your daily moisturizer to promote a radiant complexion. Add one drop to shampoo and massage into hair to soothe a dry scalp. After a tiring day, apply with an equal amount of Peppermint to the temples and neck. Make a homemade mouth rinse with 1/2 tsp baking soda, two tablespoons of water, two drops of Peppermint, and one drop of Patchouli. Home: Diffuse for a grounding, peaceful aroma. Add 10 drops to a spray bottle filled with water and spritz all over during outdoor activities for a pleasant aroma. Therapeutic use: Used in aromatherapy as a sedative and calmative. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve acne and boils. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve minor skin irritations, cuts, bruises, and burns. Used in aromatherapy to help relieve symptoms of digestive discomfort such as flatulence and cramps.
products.cautions_en: Do not use in the mouth. Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with vegetable oil. If swallowed, call emergency medical services or a Poison Control Centre immediately. Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you have a history of epilepsy or asthma, or if symptoms worsen after use. Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Avoid exposing the application area to sunlight for 24 to 48 hours. Discontinue use if nausea, dizziness, headache, or other hypersensitivity/allergy reactions occur. Consult a health care practitioner for prolonged use.

products.intro_zh: 为年轻光彩   花漾年华复方精油 含有强效焕新功效且配方珍贵的花漾年华复方精油是doTERRA护肤的终极解决方案。花漾年华复方精油采用了世界几款珍贵的精油精制而成，可以减少皮肤瑕疵，帮助消除皮肤老化的迹象。 花漾年华复方精油蕴含多种备受推崇、外用功效持久的护肤精油，包括乳香、檀香木、薰衣草、没药、永久花和玫瑰。每日重点涂抹于额头、笑纹和颈部等目标部位一至两次，有助舒缓肌肤，焕发活力，让肤色焕发年轻光彩。花漾年华复方采用滚珠瓶设计，方便均匀涂抹，确保每一滴珍贵的精油都能滋润您的肌肤。
products.tips_zh: 在面部和颈部涂抹薄薄一层。然后使用您选择的 doTERRA 保湿霜。 在早晚面部护理程序加入花漾年华复方精油。 将花漾年华复方精油涂抹在需要减少瑕疵的部位。 涂抹花漾年华复方精油于颈部和脉搏点，散发舒缓香气。
products.directions_zh: 外用：在所需区域涂抹。用基底油稀释以降低皮肤过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

products.intro_en: For a youthful glow. With powerful renewing benefits and a precious formula, Immortelle is the ultimate dōTERRA skin care solution. Crafted from some of the world's most precious essential oils, Immortelle can reduce the appearance of skin imperfections and help minimize the signs of aging. It features highly regarded essential oils with lasting topical benefits, including Frankincense, Sandalwood, Lavender, Myrrh, Helichrysum, and Rose. Apply once or twice daily to target areas such as the forehead, smile lines, and neck to help soothe and revitalize skin for a youthful, radiant complexion. The convenient roll-on bottle allows for even application so every precious drop nourishes your skin.
products.claims_en: Reduces the appearance of skin imperfections. May help reduce the appearance of aging skin. Helps keep skin smooth and radiant. Promotes a radiant, youthful complexion.
products.tips_en: Apply a thin layer to the face and neck, then follow with your choice of dōTERRA moisturizer. Add Immortelle to your morning and evening facial routine. Apply to areas where you want to reduce the appearance of imperfections. Apply to the neck and pulse points for a soothing aroma.
products.directions_en: Topical use: Apply to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

products.claims_en: Floral, minty, peaceful aroma. Provides a comforting aroma during massage. Helps create a calm environment.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Diffuse at bedtime to create a calming environment and promote restful sleep. Rub one drop between your palms and inhale deeply for a tranquil aroma. Massage onto the bottoms of feet for a relaxing aroma. Home use: Diffuse during challenging moments for a reassuring aroma. Place a drop on a cotton ball in your car's air vent for a soothing aroma.

products.intro_zh: 精油之王   乳香精油 乳香精油被誉 为“精油之王”，当外用或芳香使用时，它具有无与伦比的功效。乳香精油在漫漫历史上被誉为地球最珍贵的物质之一。乳香精油因具有美容特性而被使用数个世纪之久，特别是用于恢复肌肤外观的年轻。如今，乳香精油在局部和芳香使用时具有非凡的功效。 乳香精油具有滋养、舒缓的外用涂抹效果，当添加至日常护肤品中，有助维持健康的肤色。当扩香使用，其温暖、辛香、草本的气息有助营造极度放松以及平和的氛围。 采购乳香：doTERRA乳香精油所使用的乳香品种生长于不同的土壤和区域，而借由doTERRA Co-impact Sourcing 互相效力合作计划有助分散供应压力，进而创造未来可持续性的收成解决方案。
products.tips_zh: 在反省或冥想时，扩香使用乳香精油。 将乳香精油加入乳霜或乳液中或直接涂抹，为肌肤提供滋养和舒缓之效。 涂抹于足底，有助稳定心神并集中每日意念。 每日涂抹于角质层，有助维持健康的甲床。 将一滴精油加入数盎司的清水中，用于漱口，有助促进健康的牙龈、口腔和牙齿。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：在各式芳香喷雾器中倒入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一至两滴精油涂抹于欲使用之部位。搭配基底油稀释使用以减少肌肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

products.intro_en: The King of Oils. Frankincense, known as the "King of Oils," offers unparalleled benefits when used topically or aromatically. Throughout history, Frankincense has been prized as one of the earth's most precious substances and has been used for centuries for its beautifying properties, especially for restoring a youthful-looking complexion. Today, Frankincense remains remarkable when used topically and aromatically. With nourishing, soothing topical benefits, it helps maintain a healthy-looking complexion when added to your daily skin care routine. When diffused, its warm, spicy, herbaceous aroma helps create a deeply relaxing and peaceful atmosphere. Sourcing Frankincense: The Frankincense species used in dōTERRA Frankincense grow in different soils and regions. Through dōTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing, supply pressure is spread out, creating sustainable harvesting solutions for the future.
products.claims_en: Releases a relaxing, uplifting aroma. When applied topically, helps maintain healthy-looking skin. Soothes and moisturizes dry skin. Helps maintain healthy cuticles and nails. Helps cleanse teeth and gums.
products.tips_en: Diffuse Frankincense during reflection or meditation. Add to creams or lotions, or apply directly, for nourishing and soothing benefits for the skin. Apply to the bottoms of feet to help ground and focus your daily intentions. Apply to cuticles daily to help maintain healthy nail beds. Add one drop to a few ounces of water and use as a mouth rinse to help promote healthy gums, mouth, and teeth.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

products.intro_zh: 伊兰伊兰精油萃取自热带伊兰树的星状花朵，它以甜美、香水般的香氛而闻名。伊兰伊兰美丽且用途广泛，是护肤和护发程序的丰富成分。
products.desc_zh: 伊兰伊兰精油对皮肤、头发和芳香的功用使它成为任何系列的三大必备支柱。为了让您的肌肤焕然一新，可在脸部保湿霜中添加一滴伊兰伊兰，或轻轻按摩头皮，让头发发丝健康。您还可以将伊兰伊兰融入您的个人和日常护理程序中，作为 DIY 蒸汽面部护理、泥面膜和免冲洗护发素的成分。在温水浴中加入一滴伊兰伊兰，尽情享受柔和、舒缓的香氛，或在晚上扩香，营造平静、积极的氛围。
products.tips_zh: 用于蒸气脸部护理，使肌肤焕然一新。 取一滴涂抹于手腕散发香甜花香的气味。 将几滴混合泻盐再加入温水中，享受轻松的沐浴。 与基底油混合并涂抹在头发，用作深层护发乳。 于头皮按摩伊兰伊兰精油提升头发的健康与光泽。 扩香伊兰伊兰精油体验镇静香氛。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。

products.intro_en: Extracted from the star-shaped flowers of the tropical Ylang Ylang tree, Ylang Ylang essential oil is known for its sweet, perfume-like fragrance. Beautiful and versatile, Ylang Ylang is a rich addition to skin and hair care routines.
products.claims_en: Sweet, uplifting, calming aroma. Nourishes hair. Moisturizes the scalp for healthy, shiny-looking hair. Freshens air and linens. Helps cleanse the skin. Has an invigorating effect on the skin.
products.tips_en: Use in a facial steam to refresh skin. Apply one drop to the wrists for a sweet floral scent. Add a few drops to Epsom salt and warm bathwater for a relaxing bath. Mix with a carrier oil and apply to hair as a deep conditioner. Massage Ylang Ylang into the scalp to promote healthy, shiny-looking hair. Diffuse Ylang Ylang for a calming aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. For external use only.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Ylang Ylang's benefits for skin, hair, and aroma make it a must-have pillar of any collection. To refresh your skin, add a drop to your facial moisturizer, or gently massage it into the scalp for healthy-looking hair. You can also incorporate Ylang Ylang into your personal care routine as an ingredient in DIY facial steams, clay masks, and leave-in conditioners. Add a drop to a warm bath to enjoy its soft, soothing aroma, or diffuse it in the evening to create a calm, positive atmosphere.

products.origin: 佛手柑是最娇嫩的柑橘植物，需要在特定的气候与土壤才能茁壮生长。
products.intro_zh: 独特的柑橘   佛手柑精油 佛手柑精油在柑橘类精油中独具特色，其甜美细致的香氛能营造令人振奋又平静的环境。佛手柑精油富含柠檬烯，这是其主要化学成分之一，因此具有强效的表面清洁特性。 佛手柑是最娇嫩的柑橘植物，需要在特定的气候与土壤才能茁壮生长。义大利人多年来一直使用佛手柑精油来呵护肌肤。在希腊，未成熟的果实会被制成果脯，作为甜点或搭配咖啡，以一匙一匙的方式享用。
products.tips_zh: 在教室、工作场所或家中扩香佛手柑精油。 沐浴时将佛手柑精油涂抹于肌肤，并深呼吸。 于红茶滴入一滴佛手柑精油以享伯爵茶般的滋味。 将几滴佛手柑精油加入温水中，享受放松的泡脚时光。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 食用: 取一滴以 4 盎司的饮品搭配食用。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。请参阅下方的注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。使用后12小时内请远离阳光或紫外线照射。

products.intro_en: A unique citrus. Bergamot stands out among citrus oils; its sweet, delicate aroma creates an uplifting yet calming environment. Rich in limonene, one of its main chemical constituents, Bergamot has powerful surface-cleansing properties. Bergamot is the most delicate of citrus plants, requiring a specific climate and soil to thrive. Italians have used Bergamot for years to care for the skin. In Greece, the unripe fruit is made into a candied preserve, enjoyed by the spoonful as a dessert or with coffee.
products.claims_en: Bright, citrus, spicy aroma. Add to water or recipes for a bright, citrus flavour. Cleanses surfaces and helps remove sticky residue. May help cleanse the skin. Has an invigorating, revitalizing effect on the skin.
products.tips_en: Diffuse Bergamot in the classroom, workplace, or at home. Apply Bergamot to skin while showering and breathe deeply. Add one drop to black tea for an Earl Grey–like flavour. Add a few drops to warm water for a relaxing foot soak.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Avoid sunlight or UV rays for up to 12 hours after applying product.
products.origin_en: Bergamot is the most delicate of citrus plants, requiring a specific climate and soil to thrive.

products.intro_zh: 薰衣草精油以镇静的香氛及舒缓和舒适肌肤的功效而闻名。doTERRA呵护系列-薰衣草滚珠精油将薰衣草精油与分馏椰子油结合，包装在易于涂抹使用的滚珠瓶，对娇嫩或敏感皮肤的人尤其温和。
products.desc_zh: 每次温和地滚涂doTERRA 呵护系列-薰衣草滚珠精油都可帮助舒适和滋润干燥的皮肤，同时促进柔软、健康的肤色。全天将 doTERRA 呵护系列-薰衣草滚珠精油涂抹在太阳穴、颈后、脚底和其他脉搏点，让皮肤体验愉悦舒缓和镇定芳香的效果。凭借便捷的滚珠瓶，doTERRA 呵护系列-薰衣草滚珠精油非常适合有针对性、不脏手的涂抹方式，而分馏椰子油则有助增加吸收并降低皮肤敏感的机会。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 睡前涂抹于脚底带来令人放松的香氛，促进睡眠安宁。 涂抹于太阳穴或颈后为皮肤带来舒适清凉的效果。 涂抹于指甲上，以滋润和舒缓角质层。 涂抹在有需要部位享受舒缓感觉。
products.directions_zh: 外用: 将滚珠精油涂抹到所需部位。请参阅以下的注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Soothes and moisturizes dry skin Provides a cooling sensation to skin Has a relaxing, peaceful, calming aroma Gentle on sensitive skin
products.intro_en: Lavender is known for its calming aroma and its soothing, comforting benefits for the skin. dōTERRA Touch Lavender combines Lavender with Fractionated Coconut Oil in an easy-to-use roller bottle, making it especially gentle for those with delicate or sensitive skin.
products.claims_en: Soothes and moisturizes dry skin. Provides a cooling sensation to the skin. Relaxing, calming, soothing aroma. Gentle on sensitive skin.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Apply to the bottoms of feet before bed for a relaxing aroma that promotes restful sleep. Apply to the temples or back of the neck for a comforting, cooling effect on the skin. Apply to nails to moisturize and soothe cuticles. Apply to areas in need of a soothing sensation.
products.directions_en: Topical use: Apply roll-on to desired area. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Each gentle roll of dōTERRA Touch Lavender helps comfort and moisturize dry skin while promoting a soft, healthy-looking complexion. Apply to the temples, back of the neck, bottoms of feet, and other pulse points throughout the day for a pleasantly soothing feel and calming aroma. With its convenient roller bottle, Lavender Touch is ideal for targeted, mess-free application, while Fractionated Coconut Oil helps enhance absorption and reduce the chance of skin sensitivity.

products.claims_zh: 香气具有镇静特性 可帮助保持口腔卫生 可促进肌肤气色健康
products.skin: 敏感肌/儿童需稀释
products.origin: 这种开浅紫色花朵的绿色浓密小型灌木原产于东南亚，在印度保健疗法中有一定的应用历史。
products.intro_zh: 这种开浅紫色花朵的绿色浓密小型灌木原产于东南亚，在印度保健疗法中有一定的应用历史。Tulsi（圣罗勒）意为“无与伦比之物”，被奉为“药草皇后” 世界各地的许多文化中都将之用于文化习俗和传统仪式的一部分。圣罗勒精油舒缓的香气让人联想到介乎传统罗勒精油和丁香精油的混合物，带有薄荷精油和甘草的味道。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把圣罗勒精油纳入收藏? 与其近亲甜罗勒不一样，圣罗勒精油温暖甜美的香气可营造出醉人的氛围，让人联想到新鲜切碎的罗勒。它的香味营造出令人振奋和引人入胜的氛围。与热性丁香精油的化学成分相同，圣罗勒精油有大量丁香酚。然而，圣罗勒精油比较温和，涂抹于皮肤可以帮助保持皮肤健康乾净。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 将一滴圣罗勒精油加入两盎司的水中用来漱口，以清洁口腔和清新口气。 作为护肤程序，在洗面乳或乳液中加入一滴圣罗勒精油。 取一滴圣罗勒精油于掌心，揉搓双掌，然后用手罩住鼻子并吸气。 居家用 扩香圣罗勒精油，营造宁静氛围。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用: 于所需部位涂抹一至两滴。 用基底油稀释以降低肌肤敏感。 详情请参阅以下注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。仅限外用。
products.benefits_en: Has a calming aroma May help maintain good oral hygiene May support the appearance of healthy skin
products.intro_en: Native to Southeast Asia, this dense, green shrub with pale purple flowers has a history of use in Indian wellness practices. Tulsi (Holy Basil) means "the incomparable one" and is revered as the "Queen of Herbs," used in cultural customs and traditional ceremonies in many cultures around the world. Its soothing aroma is reminiscent of a blend of traditional Basil and Clove, with hints of Peppermint and licorice.
products.claims_en: Aroma has calming properties. May help maintain oral hygiene. May promote a healthy-looking complexion.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Add one drop of Tulsi to two ounces of water as a mouth rinse to cleanse the mouth and freshen breath. Add one drop to your facial cleanser or lotion as part of your skin care routine. Place one drop in your palm, rub hands together, cup over your nose, and inhale. Home use: Diffuse Tulsi to create a peaceful atmosphere.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. For external use only.
products.origin_en: Native to Southeast Asia, this dense, green shrub with pale purple flowers has a history of use in Indian wellness practices.
products.skin_en: Dilute for sensitive skin or children
products.desc_en: Why add Tulsi to your collection? Unlike its close relative Sweet Basil, Tulsi has a warm, sweet aroma that creates an inviting atmosphere reminiscent of freshly chopped basil, and its scent creates an uplifting, engaging environment. Sharing a chemistry with warming Clove, Tulsi contains a high amount of eugenol. However, Tulsi is milder and, when applied to the skin, can help keep skin clean and healthy-looking.

products.claims_zh: 具有放松，镇定，舒缓的香气 使秀发拥有健康外观 改善皮肤质感，使年轻有光泽
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.constituents: α-檀香醇、ß-檀香醇、澳白檀醇
products.intro_zh: 檀香木具有与一般芳香植物不同能持续数十年的香气因得此名。檀香木与檀香木精油数百年来皆被视为极其珍贵之物。蒸汽蒸馏夏威夷檀香树的芳香木材，夏威夷檀香精油具有浓郁、木质调和微妙的甜香。按摩时使用夏威夷檀香精油有助舒缓和改善肤质，使肤色年轻亮泽。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把夏威夷檀香精油纳入收藏? 夏威夷檀香精油因其朴实无华的效用而成为最受欢迎的精油之一。它的功效归功于高浓度的檀香醇化学成分，特别是 α-檀香醇和 ß-檀香醇，将夏威夷檀香精油的镇静舒缓香氛发挥至极致。扩香夏威夷檀香可缔造一个进行完美个人冥想或与人互动的积极环境。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 泡澡时滴入两滴夏威夷檀香精油，营造放松的氛围。 滴一滴夏威夷檀香精油入洗发乳或日常保湿霜以改善发质与肤质的外观。 于脸部蒸气机滴入两滴夏威夷檀香精油帮助滋润与活络肌肤。 搭配肌肤保养程序使用夏威夷檀香精油让肌肤展现滑顺的质地与健康的光泽。 居家用 就寝时扩香三至四滴夏威夷檀香精油以享镇静香气。 忙碌充满压力的一天后或静坐前可于卧室扩香三至四滴夏威夷檀香精油。 滴一滴夏威夷檀香精油于棉花球再置于车内出风口开车时散发舒缓香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Sandalwood is known for an aroma that, unlike most aromatic plants, can last for decades. Sandalwood and its oil have been considered extremely precious for centuries. Steam-distilled from the aromatic wood of the Hawaiian sandalwood tree, Hawaiian Sandalwood has a rich, woody aroma with subtle sweetness. Used during massage, it helps soothe and improve skin texture for a youthful, radiant complexion.
products.claims_en: Relaxing, calming, soothing aroma. Promotes healthy-looking hair. Improves skin texture for a youthful, radiant appearance.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Add two drops of Hawaiian Sandalwood to a bath to create a relaxing atmosphere. Add one drop to shampoo or daily moisturizer to improve the appearance of hair and skin. Add two drops to a facial steamer to help hydrate and revitalize skin. Use with your skin care routine for a smooth texture and healthy glow. Home use: Diffuse three to four drops at bedtime for a calming aroma. Diffuse three to four drops in the bedroom after a busy, stressful day or before meditation. Place one drop on a cotton ball in your car's air vent for a soothing aroma while driving.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Why add Hawaiian Sandalwood to your collection? Hawaiian Sandalwood is one of the most popular oils for its grounding benefits. These benefits come from its high concentration of santalols, particularly α-santalol and β-santalol, which maximize its calming, soothing aroma. Diffuse Hawaiian Sandalwood to create a positive environment for personal meditation or connecting with others.

products.claims_zh: 稀释并涂于目标部位，可增添新鲜香气 稀释并涂于目标部位，可帮助清洁皮肤和头皮 可以改善皮肤外观 舒缓干燥皮肤 改善头发的外观 按摩时，提供令人放松，花香的香气
products.skin: 稀释后局部使用 具有草本，和谐，甜美，花香的香气
products.constituents: 香茅醇、甲酸香茅酯、香叶醇
products.origin: 天竺葵是天竺葵属的成员，它因美丽而被种植，是香水行业的香味翘楚。
products.intro_zh: 天竺葵是天竺葵属的成员，它因美丽而被种植，是香水行业的香味翘楚。天竺葵的用途可追溯到古埃及，古时它被用来美化皮肤和头发。 doTERRA 天竺葵精油现在仍使用在皮肤和头发，为您的日常美容程序锦上添花。
products.desc_zh: 天竺葵精油富含香茅醇和香叶醇，可促进肌肤洁净和头发健康，是皮肤和头发护理的理想之选。在您的日常护发产品中添加几滴天竺葵精油，让您的头皮保持健康和清洁，或透过稀释后外用涂抹，享受它对皮肤的益处。天竺葵精油具有清新的花香，扩香后营造平静、轻松的氛围，把它涂抹在皮肤作为个人香水的首选香气。
products.tips_zh: 在蒸气脸部护理时使用天竺葵精油美化肌肤。 于日常脸部保湿霜滴入一滴天竺葵精油以缓解干燥并改善皮肤外观。 于洗发乳或护发素中滴入几滴天竺葵精油或打造个人调制的深层护发素。 扩香天竺葵精油享受镇静香氛。 将天竺葵精油加入饮料或甜点作调味之用。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a harmonious, sweet, floral aroma Promotes the appearance of clear, healthy skin Gives hair and scalp a vibrant, healthy glow Soothes dry skin
products.intro_en: A member of the Pelargonium genus, Geranium is cultivated for its beauty and is a leading fragrance in the perfume industry. Geranium's use dates back to ancient Egypt, when it was used to beautify skin and hair. Today, dōTERRA Geranium is still used for skin and hair, a lovely addition to your daily beauty routine.
products.claims_en: Diluted and applied to target areas, adds a fresh scent. Diluted and applied to target areas, helps cleanse skin and scalp. May improve the appearance of skin. Soothes dry skin. Improves the appearance of hair. Provides a relaxing, floral aroma during massage.
products.tips_en: Use Geranium in a facial steam to beautify skin. Add a drop to your daily facial moisturizer to relieve dryness and improve the appearance of skin. Add a few drops to shampoo or conditioner, or create your own deep conditioner. Diffuse Geranium for a calming aroma. Add Geranium to beverages or desserts for flavour.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: A member of the Pelargonium genus, Geranium is cultivated for its beauty and is a leading fragrance in the perfume industry.
products.skin_en: Dilute for topical use
products.desc_en: Rich in citronellol and geraniol, Geranium promotes clean skin and healthy-looking hair, making it ideal for skin and hair care. Add a few drops to your daily hair care products to keep your scalp healthy and clean, or dilute and apply topically to enjoy its skin benefits. With its fresh floral aroma, Geranium creates a calm, relaxing atmosphere when diffused and is a favourite personal fragrance when applied to the skin.

products.claims_zh: 具有轻松，大自然，朴实的香气 有活化皮肤作用 按摩时，提供镇定的香气
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.constituents: 香芹酮、异朱栾倍半萜、倍半萜醇
products.origin: 源自香根草粗壮的根部，岩兰草精油以安定宁神的香气著称，通常用于按摩和香水。 岩兰草精油通过doTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®互相效力合作计划从海地采购。
products.intro_zh: 源自香根草粗壮的根部，岩兰草精油以安定宁神的香气著称，通常用于按摩和香水。它令人放松的香气营造宁静的氛围，在忙碌的一天过后尤其有用。岩兰草精油通过doTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®互相效力合作计划从海地采购。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把岩兰草精油纳入收藏? 岩兰草含有多种倍半萜（植物中具有强烈气味的有机化合物），包括香芹酮、异朱栾倍半萜和倍半萜醇。这些化合物赋予岩兰草精油出格的香气，对比其他根系或植物精油有著更胜一筹的香气，这使得岩兰草精油在芳香调理和局部涂抹的功效格外显著。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 泡澡时滴入两滴岩兰草精油散发放松的香氛。 于保湿霜加入一滴岩兰草精油促进活力青春的肤质。 涂抹一至两滴岩兰草精油于颈部和手腕散发个人专属的朴实香气。 睡前涂抹两滴岩兰草精油于足底以享大地香气。 长时间站立后混合三至四滴岩兰草精油和分馏椰子油涂抹于足部和腿部进行舒缓按摩散发镇静香气。 居家用 自制扩香配方时加入一至两滴岩兰草精油可做为散发大地气息的基底香。 搭配一滴岩兰草精油和相同份量的薰衣草精油和野橘精油扩香以享放松和振奋人心的香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a relaxing, earthy, grounding aroma Has a revitalizing effect on the skin Provides a calming aroma during a massage
products.intro_en: Derived from the robust roots of the vetiver grass, Vetiver is known for its grounding, calming aroma and is often used in massage and perfumery. Its relaxing aroma creates a tranquil atmosphere, especially welcome after a busy day. Vetiver is sourced from Haiti through dōTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®.
products.claims_en: Relaxing, natural, earthy aroma. Revitalizes the skin. Provides a calming aroma during massage.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Add two drops of Vetiver to a bath for a relaxing aroma. Add one drop to your moisturizer to promote a vibrant, youthful complexion. Apply one to two drops to the neck and wrists for a signature earthy scent. Apply two drops to the bottoms of feet before bed for a grounding aroma. After standing for long periods, mix three to four drops with Fractionated Coconut Oil for a soothing foot and leg massage with a calming aroma. Home use: Add one to two drops to your homemade diffuser blends as an earthy base note. Diffuse one drop of Vetiver with equal amounts of Lavender and Wild Orange for a relaxing yet uplifting aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Derived from the robust roots of the vetiver grass, Vetiver is known for its grounding, calming aroma and is often used in massage and perfumery. Vetiver is sourced from Haiti through dōTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Why add Vetiver to your collection? Vetiver contains several sesquiterpenes (strongly aromatic organic compounds found in plants), including α-vetivone, isovalencenol, and khusimol. These compounds give Vetiver its distinctive aroma, richer than that of other root or plant oils, making its aromatic and topical benefits especially notable.

products.claims_zh: 具有镇静的香氛 舒缓和滋润肌肤 支持皮肤的外观健康 营造有助冥想的静谧氛围
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.origin: 采购愈创木: doTERRA CPTG®专业纯正检测认证愈创木精油采购自巴拉圭，并遵循可持续和道德的采购方式。
products.intro_zh: 愈创木精油取自玉檀木的心材，经蒸汽蒸馏制成，它散发著大地气息和镇静的香气，同时亦带有些微的甜味。包含分馏椰子油，愈创木精油温和在皮肤上滑动，其独特的木质香气营造出平静、静谧的氛围。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把愈创木精油纳入收藏? 由于其著名的香气和外用涂抹益处，愈创木经常见于香水和护肤产品中。在晚间按摩或护肤程序使用doTERRA愈创木增添舒缓、温和的触感，练习瑜伽时扩香，其大地气息的芳香特性还可以营造增强活力的氛围。 采购愈创木: doTERRA CPTG®专业纯正检测认证愈创木精油采购自巴拉圭，并遵循可持续和道德的采购方式。我们与合作伙伴携手合作，致力于扭转大厦谷岌岌可危的生态环境—该处是全球生物多样性最丰富的地区之一。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 涂抹一至两滴愈创木精油在皮肤所需的区域，以获得保湿体验。 愈创木具有大地气息的香氛，可融入在舒缓肩部的按摩。 在忙碌的午后，将愈创木涂抹在脉搏点享受大地气息的香氛。 居家用 全天候扩香使用愈创木，抑或是于瑜伽或冥想练习时，感受支持力的香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用: 将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。请参阅下方的注意事项。
products.cautions_zh: 可能引起肌肤过敏。请放置孩童伸手不及处。怀孕或接受治疗者请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Provides a grounding aroma Soothes and hydrates skin Supports the appearance of healthy skin Promotes a tranquil atmosphere helpful for meditation
products.intro_en: Steam-distilled from the heartwood of the palo santo tree, Guaiacwood has an earthy, calming aroma with a hint of sweetness. Containing Fractionated Coconut Oil, Guaiacwood glides gently over the skin, and its unique woody aroma creates a calm, tranquil atmosphere.
products.claims_en: Calming aroma. Soothes and moisturizes skin. Supports a healthy-looking complexion. Creates a tranquil atmosphere conducive to meditation.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Apply one to two drops to desired areas of skin for a moisturizing experience. Incorporate Guaiacwood's earthy aroma into a soothing shoulder massage. On a busy afternoon, apply to pulse points to enjoy its earthy aroma. Home use: Diffuse Guaiacwood throughout the day or during yoga or meditation for a supportive aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Sourcing Guaiacwood: dōTERRA CPTG® Guaiacwood is sourced from Paraguay using sustainable and ethical sourcing practices.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Why add Guaiacwood to your collection? Known for its aroma and topical benefits, Guaiacwood is often found in perfumes and skin care products. Use dōTERRA Guaiacwood in an evening massage or skin care routine for a soothing, gentle touch, or diffuse it during yoga; its earthy aromatic properties help create an energizing atmosphere. Sourcing Guaiacwood: dōTERRA CPTG® Guaiacwood is sourced from Paraguay using sustainable and ethical sourcing practices. We work with our partners to help restore the threatened ecosystem of the Gran Chaco, one of the most biodiverse regions in the world.

products.claims_zh: 具有新鲜，通畅，柠檬类，提升的香气 可以帮助清洁皮肤 促进皮肤外观健康 清洁表面 具有使人愉悦的室内外香气
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.origin: 原产于澳大利亚北部，柠檬尤加利精油以其独特的户外气味并可营造充满活力的环境，还有惊人的清洁功效而闻名。
products.intro_zh: 味的蓝胶尤加利树。原产于澳大利亚北部，柠檬尤加利精油以其独特的户外气味并可营造充满活力的环境，还有惊人的清洁功效而闻名。局部涂抹需要部位，使皮肤外观更健康，或于室内和室外扩香以享振提香氛。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把柠檬尤加利精油纳入收藏? 柠檬尤加利精油是清洁表面和皮肤的理想选择，因为它有大量香茅醛和香茅醇的化学成分。除了局部清洁功效外，柠檬尤加利精油还可净化和清新空气，以及焕发活力，绝对应该随身携带。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 于洗发乳中加入一滴柠檬尤加利精油让头发外观干净。 在您日常护肤程序中，加入一至两滴柠檬尤加利精油到您喜爱的doTERRA洗面乳。 用柠檬尤加利精油按摩胸腔位置或手掌以获得令人振奋的香气。 以5滴分馏椰子油稀释一滴柠檬尤加利精油于舒缓、提振按摩使用。 居家用 于室内和室外扩香三至四滴柠檬尤加利精油，用明亮清新的香味营造积极的环境。 于喷雾瓶以10滴柠檬尤加利精油混合水可清洁桌面、流理台等各式表面。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。放置处应远离孩童。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。请将本产品放在儿童接触不到的地方。如果意外摄入，请立即致电毒物控制中心或医生，并告知他们该产品含有尤加利精油。
products.intro_en: Native to northern Australia, Lemon Eucalyptus is known for its distinctive outdoor scent, its ability to create an energizing environment, and its impressive cleansing properties. Apply topically to desired areas for healthier-looking skin, or diffuse indoors and outdoors for an uplifting aroma.
products.claims_en: Fresh, clean, lemony, uplifting aroma. May help cleanse the skin. Promotes healthy-looking skin. Cleanses surfaces. Pleasant aroma for indoors and outdoors.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Add one drop to shampoo for clean-looking hair. Add one to two drops to your favourite dōTERRA facial cleanser as part of your daily skin care routine. Massage onto the chest or palms for an invigorating aroma. Dilute one drop with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil for a soothing, uplifting massage. Home use: Diffuse three to four drops indoors or outdoors to create a positive environment with a bright, fresh scent. Combine 10 drops with water in a spray bottle to clean tables, countertops, and other surfaces.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Keep this product out of reach of children. If accidentally ingested, immediately call a poison control centre or doctor and inform them that the product contains eucalyptus oil.
products.origin_en: Native to northern Australia, Lemon Eucalyptus is known for its distinctive outdoor scent, its ability to create an energizing environment, and its impressive cleansing properties.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Why add Lemon Eucalyptus to your collection? Lemon Eucalyptus is ideal for cleansing surfaces and skin thanks to its high levels of citronellal and citronellol. Beyond its topical cleansing benefits, Lemon Eucalyptus purifies and freshens the air and is energizing, so it's well worth keeping on hand.

products.claims_zh: 具有浪漫，花香的香气 平衡皮肤中的水分含量 促进肤色明亮，健康 按摩时，提供令人提升，丰富的香气
products.skin: 可先稀释后用于易敏感肌肤
products.constituents: 香茅醇、香叶醇、十九烷、橙花醇
products.intro_zh: 玫瑰精油是从成千上万的玫瑰花瓣中精心提取和蒸馏而成的，具有花香、浪漫的香气，最常用于芳香调理或局部涂抹。玫瑰精油营造振奋，舒适的氛围，结合护肤品使用，有效平衡皮肤中的水分促进皮肤外观健康。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把玫瑰精油纳入收藏? 玫瑰精油具有丰富、甜美的香气以及对皮肤有莫大的好处，因而在其他花类精油中脱颖而出，有著“精油之后”的美誉。玫瑰精油具有高浓度的香叶醇—一种在护肤精油中常见的化学成分—其光滑柔和的黏度平衡皮肤中的水分含量，让肌肤焕发健康光泽。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 涂抹两滴玫瑰精油于手腕和颈部作为个人香水，以获取独特的甜香。 使用一至两滴玫瑰精油并用于按摩享受舒缓及放松的香氛。 加入一至两滴玫瑰精油至面部保湿霜以帮助平衡皮肤中的水分含量。 每日两次涂抹一滴玫瑰精油在所需部位来增强皮肤的外观健康。 居家用 扩香三至四滴玫瑰精油，散发出令人振奋浪漫香气。 于扩香珠宝滴入数滴玫瑰精油享受镇定的香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。放置处应远离孩童。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a romantic, floral aroma Balances moisture levels in the skin Promotes a glowing, healthy-looking complexion Provides an elevating, enriching aroma during a massage
products.intro_en: Carefully extracted and distilled from thousands of rose petals, Rose has a floral, romantic aroma and is most commonly used aromatically or topically. Rose creates an uplifting, comforting atmosphere and, combined with skin care products, helps balance skin moisture and promote a healthy-looking complexion.
products.claims_en: Romantic, floral aroma. Balances moisture levels in the skin. Promotes an even, healthy-looking complexion. Provides an uplifting, rich aroma during massage.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Apply two drops to the wrists and neck as a personal perfume for a unique sweet scent. Use one to two drops during massage for a soothing, relaxing aroma. Add one to two drops to your facial moisturizer to help balance skin moisture. Apply one drop to desired areas twice daily to enhance a healthy-looking complexion. Home use: Diffuse three to four drops for an uplifting, romantic aroma. Add a few drops to diffuser jewellery for a calming aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Dilute before use on sensitive skin
products.desc_en: Why add Rose to your collection? With its rich, sweet aroma and remarkable skin benefits, Rose stands out among floral oils and is known as the "Queen of Oils." Rose has a high concentration of geraniol, a constituent commonly found in skin care oils, and its smooth, gentle viscosity helps balance skin moisture for a healthy-looking glow.

products.claims_zh: 散发清新、提振、苏醒的香氛。于水或食谱中添加以享阵阵柑橘风味可以改善皮肤外观有效清洁表面。
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.intro_zh: 甜橘精油以甜美、酸香的香氛照亮任何空间。这款柑橘系精油令人振奋的芳香品质、烹饪功效和丰富的清洁特性而广受赞誉和爱戴。
products.desc_zh: 经过完美冷压，甜橘精油是香甜且用途广泛的柑橘系精油。扩香甜橘可为您最喜爱的空间带来令人愉悦、充满活力的氛围。甜橘还可以增强甜点、饮料和其他需要柑橘味道食谱的风味。 CPTG® 专业纯正检测认证的甜橘精油具有高浓度的柠檬烯，使它成为卓越的表面清洁剂。在您的多功能清洁喷雾中添加几滴以清洁表面或在您的晚间护肤程序添加一滴，让肤色焕然一新。
products.tips_zh: 制作蛋糕或饼干时加入甜橘精油特显风味。 于饮用水、果昔、茶饮或柠檬饮料中滴入一至两滴甜橘精油增添味觉层次。 将甜橘精油添加到您最喜欢的喷雾器中，享受愉悦的香氛。 涂抹于穴位或脉搏进行提振按摩。 在晚间保养品中加入一滴，打造清新、洁净的妆感。 滴1滴入多功能清洁喷雾以清洁家居表面。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。使用后12小时内请远离阳光或紫外线照射。
products.benefits_en: Delivers a refreshing, invigorating, and elevating aroma. Adds a twist of citrus flavour to water and recipes Can improve the appearance of skin Effectively cleans surfaces.
products.intro_en: Tangerine brightens any space with its sweet, tangy aroma. This citrus oil is widely loved for its uplifting aromatic qualities, culinary uses, and rich cleansing properties.
products.claims_en: Fresh, uplifting, awakening aroma. Add to water or recipes for a burst of citrus flavour. May improve the appearance of skin. Effectively cleanses surfaces.
products.tips_en: Add Tangerine to cakes or cookies for extra flavour. Add one to two drops to water, smoothies, tea, or lemonade for added taste. Add Tangerine to your favourite diffuser for a cheerful aroma. Apply to pressure points or pulse points for an uplifting massage. Add a drop to your evening skin care products for a fresh, clean look. Add 1 drop to an all-purpose cleaning spray to clean household surfaces.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Avoid sunlight or UV rays for up to 12 hours after applying product.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Perfectly cold-pressed, Tangerine is a sweet, versatile citrus oil. Diffuse Tangerine to bring a cheerful, energizing atmosphere to your favourite spaces. Tangerine can also enhance the flavour of desserts, beverages, and other recipes that call for citrus. CPTG® Tangerine has a high concentration of limonene, making it an excellent surface cleanser. Add a few drops to your all-purpose cleaning spray to clean surfaces, or add a drop to your evening skin care routine to refresh your complexion.

products.claims_zh: 具有甜美，甘草，蜂蜜类，活力的香气 于水或食谱中添加以享独特的甘草风味 清新口气 为肌肤带来舒缓的感觉 促进干净，健康肤色
products.skin: 可先稀释后用于易敏感肌肤
products.intro_zh: 茴香的历史可以追溯到古罗马时代，据说罗马武士准备战斗时会食用茴香。今天，茴香精油以其独特的甘草风味而闻名，可用于为甜点调味，并以其清新、甜美的香气来丰富任何环境。当外用涂抹时，茴香精油可舒缓皮肤，并有助于保持皮肤健康。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把茴香精油纳入收藏? 茴香精油本身的芳香之所以充满活力和具提振功效全因为它的化学成分。E-茴香脑是茴香精油的
products.tips_zh: 保养用 以甜茴香精油搭配日常保湿用品维持健康的肌肤。 饱餐一顿后，取一至两滴甜茴香精油涂抹腹部进行舒缓按摩。 取一滴甜茴香精油搭配一滴薰衣草精油涂抹颈部和胸口进行放松按摩。 于60毫升的水滴入一至两滴甜茴香精油漱口以清新口气。 食用 在您喜爱的甜点中加入一至两滴甜茴香精油，增添甘草风味。 于饮用水滴入一滴甜茴香精油饮用可抑制甜食欲。 居家用 于家中或办公室扩香三至四滴甜茴香精油带来能量香气帮助提高生产力。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Fennel's history dates back to ancient Rome, when Roman warriors were said to consume fennel before battle. Today, Fennel is known for its distinctive licorice flavour, used to flavour desserts, and its fresh, sweet aroma enriches any environment. When applied topically, Fennel soothes the skin and helps keep it healthy-looking.
products.claims_en: Sweet, licorice, honey-like, energizing aroma. Add to water or recipes for a unique licorice flavour. Freshens breath. Provides a soothing sensation to the skin. Promotes a clean, healthy-looking complexion.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Use Fennel with your daily moisturizer to maintain healthy-looking skin. After a large meal, apply one to two drops to the abdomen for a soothing massage. Apply one drop of Fennel with one drop of Lavender to the neck and chest for a relaxing massage. Add one to two drops to 60 mL of water and gargle to freshen breath. Internal use: Add one to two drops to your favourite desserts for a licorice flavour. Add one drop to drinking water to help curb sweet cravings. Home use: Diffuse three to four drops at home or in the office for an energizing aroma that helps boost productivity.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Dilute before use on sensitive skin
products.desc_en: Why add Fennel to your collection? Fennel's energizing, uplifting aroma comes from its chemical makeup; E-anethole is a main constituent of Fennel.

products.claims_zh: 具有木质，辛辣，陈旧的香气 按摩腹部时，提供令人振奋的香气 配合夜间保湿霜，有助软化角质和舒缓皮肤 可以改善皮肤外观 清洁指甲床，使指甲外观健康
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.origin: 穗甘松精油通过doTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®互相效力合作计划从尼泊尔采购。
products.intro_zh: 穗甘松精油是从缬草属的开花植物的根部提取，具有土质般的陈旧香气。穗甘松精油具有温和的表面清洁功能，使其非常适合用于护肤，其振奋却放松的香气在按摩界非常流行。穗甘松精油通过doTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®互相效力合作计划从尼泊尔采购。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把穗甘松精油纳入收藏? 像岩兰草精油，姜黄精油，生姜精油和其他根系精油一样，穗甘松精油散发沉稳的陈旧气味，使其整体具有朴实无华的香气。尽管穗甘松精油的柔和及提振的芳香成分与其他根系精油相似，但它具有更令人舒缓放松的深层香氛。此外，穗甘松精油有效舒缓、柔软和提供温和的皮肤清洁效果，使其成为日常皮肤护理的理想产品。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 将一滴穗甘松精油混合分馏椰子油涂抹腹部进行活络按摩散发质朴且令人放松的香气。 足浴时可滴入两到三滴穗甘松精油散发振提香气同时增强清洁效力。 于洗发乳滴入一滴穗甘松精油按摩头发与头皮支持头皮健康。 于日间或夜间保湿霜滴入一滴穗甘松精油有助滑顺或柔软肌肤。 涂抹一滴穗甘松精油于手指甲和脚趾甲帮助维持洁净与健康。 涂抹一至两滴穗甘松精油于颈部后方或太阳穴以享放松香气。 居家用 扩香三至四滴穗甘松精油以享镇静、朴素香气。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Extracted from the roots of a flowering plant in the valerian family, Spikenard has an earthy, musty aroma. Its mild surface-cleansing properties make it ideal for skin care, and its uplifting yet relaxing aroma is popular in massage. Spikenard is sourced from Nepal through dōTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®.
products.claims_en: Woody, spicy, musty aroma. Provides an invigorating aroma during abdominal massage. With a nighttime moisturizer, helps soften cuticles and soothe skin. May improve the appearance of skin. Cleanses nail beds for healthy-looking nails.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Mix one drop with Fractionated Coconut Oil for an invigorating abdominal massage with an earthy, relaxing aroma. Add two to three drops to a foot bath for an uplifting aroma and enhanced cleansing. Add one drop to shampoo and massage into hair and scalp to support a healthy scalp. Add one drop to your day or night moisturizer to help smooth and soften skin. Apply one drop to fingernails and toenails to help keep them clean and healthy-looking. Apply one to two drops to the back of the neck or temples for a relaxing aroma. Home use: Diffuse three to four drops for a calming, earthy aroma.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.origin_en: Spikenard is sourced from Nepal through dōTERRA Co-Impact Sourcing®.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Why add Spikenard to your collection? Like Vetiver, Turmeric, Ginger, and other root oils, Spikenard has a grounding, musty scent that gives it an overall earthy aroma. While its soft, uplifting aromatic profile is similar to other root oils, it has a deeper, more soothing and relaxing aroma. Spikenard also soothes, softens, and gently cleanses the skin, making it ideal for daily skin care.

Grapefruit is also known for its purifying properties and is often used in skin care to help reveal a clear, healthy-looking complexion. Grapefruit's bright, fresh flavour can also be added to water to help you meet your hydration goals, or to smoothies and your favourite açaí bowl recipes.

Since ancient times it has symbolized longevity, health, honour, and good fortune, and in ancient Egypt it was revered as a sacred flower with mystical power. Blue Lotus Touch can be used in massage, as an aid to meditation, and in full-body skin care. It also makes a captivating personal fragrance. Combining Fractionated Coconut Oil with Blue Lotus, Blue Lotus Touch provides optimal moisture and maximizes absorption of the precious essence. Sourcing Blue Lotus: Blue Lotus comes from Southeast Asia, where local families harvest the delicate flowers as they open to the morning sun. products.intro_zh: 狂野又精彩   野橘精油 野橘精油透过香甜的橙树的新鲜果皮冷压而成，是 doTERRA 最畅销的精油之一。这种用途广泛的柑橘具有令人振奋的香氛，以及多种外用、家居清洁、烹饪用途。 野橘精油富含天然化学成分柠檬烯，野橘具有多种清洁特性，可作为日常家庭表面清洁剂。扩香可使空间充满活力和振奋，为空气增添令人愉悦的新鲜感。一滴野橘精油包含了新鲜、甜美的香氛，为任何扩香配方增强香气，它亦可为菜肴或甜点增添额外的经典风味。您可滴一滴野橘精油到日常用的水瓶或早晨冰沙中享受它的味道。
products.tips_zh: 在喷雾瓶中混合野橘精油与水，喷洒在表面以增强清洁效果。 扩香野橘精油以提振心情及能量活力并清新空气。 滴 1-2 滴野橘精油在手掌上，搓揉后深吸以享充满活力的香氛。 每天在水中加入 1滴，增加风味并促进水合作用。 将野橘油添加到您最喜欢的食谱中，享受清爽的味道或作为橙皮代替。

This versatile citrus has an energizing aroma and many topical, household cleaning, and culinary uses. Rich in the naturally occurring constituent limonene, Wild Orange has many cleansing properties and can be used as an everyday household surface cleaner. A single drop holds a fresh, sweet aroma that enhances any diffuser blend, and it can add an extra classic flavour to dishes and desserts. Add Wild Orange to your favourite recipes for a refreshing flavour or as a substitute for orange zest.

products.intro_en: Sunshine in a bottle. CPTG® Lemon has a familiar, fresh, and distinctive aroma, like a ray of warm sunshine in a bottle. Known for its crisp citrus scent, Lemon helps create a bright, uplifting atmosphere and can be used as a natural, powerful cleanser. A household essential, Lemon can be used to purify indoor air and create an uplifting atmosphere. Rich in limonene, Lemon has excellent countertop-cleansing properties, making it the perfect choice for keeping countertops clean. In cooking, a drop of Lemon can add flavour to your favourite dishes and beverages. Added to water, Lemon brings a bright flavour that can help encourage daily water intake.
products.claims_en: Uplifting, positive aroma. Cleans household countertops. Helps remove sticky residue and grime. Adds a bright citrus flavour to water and cookie recipes.
products.tips_en: Combine Lemon with water in a spray bottle to clean tables, countertops, and other surfaces. Place a few drops on a cloth to help remove stubborn, sticky residue from labels or stickers. Place a few drops on a cloth to clean and polish wood furniture. Add Lemon to your drinking water and favourite dishes for a fresh citrus flavour. Diffuse Lemon to create an uplifting atmosphere.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity. See additional precautions below.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Avoid sunlight or UV rays for up to 12 hours after applying product.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution

products.claims_zh: 具有鲜明、强烈、草药的香氛具备强大的局部清洁功效按摩期间提供强化香氛于食谱中添加经典的草本味道
products.skin: 稀释后局部使用
products.intro_zh: 强效又清新   牛至精油 尽管牛至最出名的用途是煮食的香草，但牛至精油的用途远远超出厨房。牛至是所有精油中最有效、用途最多的精油之一，在传统实践中已被广泛使用了几个世纪。 牛至精油是所有精油中最有效的局部清洁剂之一，皆因它含有高浓度的酚–香芹酚和百里酚。这些化学成分赋予牛至强大、强化的香氛，最好在舒缓胸部按摩时涂抹牛至或将其涂抹在脚底。另外，您也可以在角质层上使用牛至，以促进甲床健康。牛至精油的美味草本风味也可用于您最喜欢的厨房食谱中取代一匙新鲜或干牛至香料。 由于其强烈功用，吸入或扩香牛至精油时要小心，使用一到两滴即可，涂抹于皮肤前，必须使用基底油稀释。
products.tips_zh: 与基底油混合并涂抹于脚底。 用基底油并涂抹于角质层，以保持健康的甲床。 使用牛至精油的浓郁草本香氛来增强和平衡精油。 在家煮食时使用一滴牛至精油来取代干牛至香料以增强牛至的味道。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：在所选的扩散器中使用三到四滴。 食用：在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用：涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.benefits_en: Has a sharp, pungent, herbal aroma Contains strong topical cleansing properties Provides a fortifying aroma during a massage Can be used to flavour water and recipes
products.intro_en: Powerful and fresh. Although oregano is best known as a culinary herb, Oregano oil's uses go far beyond the kitchen. One of the most potent and versatile essential oils, Oregano has been widely used in traditional practices for centuries. Oregano is one of the most effective topical cleansers among essential oils, thanks to its high concentration of the phenols carvacrol and thymol. These constituents give Oregano its strong, fortifying aroma; it is best applied during a soothing chest massage or to the bottoms of feet. You can also use Oregano on cuticles to promote healthy nail beds. Its delicious herbal flavour can also replace a spoonful of fresh or dried oregano in your favourite recipes. Because of its potency, use caution when inhaling or diffusing Oregano; one to two drops is enough, and always dilute with a carrier oil before applying to the skin.
products.claims_en: Bold, strong, herbaceous aroma. Powerful topical cleansing benefits. Provides a fortifying aroma during massage. Adds a classic herbal flavour to recipes.
products.tips_en: Mix with a carrier oil and apply to the bottoms of feet. Dilute with a carrier oil and apply to cuticles to maintain healthy nail beds. Use Oregano's rich herbal aroma to enhance and balance essential oil blends. When cooking at home, use a drop of Oregano in place of dried oregano for a boost of flavour.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Dilute for topical use

products.claims_zh: 散发悦人、草本、柠檬气息 营造清新、提振人心的氛围 外用涂抹为肌肤带来舒缓、放松感受 有效清洁台面
products.skin: 可不经稀释直接用于皮肤上
products.aroma: 清新、草本香气、甘甜、香菜辛辣
products.intro_zh: 于肌肤涂抹胡荽叶精油可享舒缓与凉爽功效，扩香时可搭配任何精油增添一股清新的草本香气。局部使用可清洁皮肤和指甲或家居表面。胡荽叶精油亦有无数的烹调功效可为肉食料理、沙拉和沾酱增添创新风味。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把胡荽叶精油纳入收藏? 像其他香料和草本精油一样，添加胡荽叶精油可增强食品菜肴的风味。除了用于烹饪外，胡荽叶精油还与其他嫩叶草本精油（例如罗勒精油）有著相同的化学成分芳樟醇，该成分可舒缓皮肤和具清洁表面性能。与其他嫩叶草本精油相比，胡荽叶精油的反式-2-癸烯成分含量高，其香气比其他嫩叶草本精油清凉，香脆，富有更强的清洁功效。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 滴一滴胡荽叶精油于漱口水以清新口气。 滴一滴胡荽叶精油于保湿用品一同使用可舒缓干燥肌肤并散发清新香气。 睡前涂抹一滴胡荽叶精油于足底以享宁静、清新的香气。 涂抹一滴胡荽叶精油于手指甲与脚趾甲保持其洁净与健康的外观。 以一至两滴胡荽叶精油搭配分馏椰子油按摩肌肤带来舒缓与镇静之效。 食用 滴数滴胡荽叶精油于沾酱、萨尔萨或鳄梨酱增添清新草本香气。 居家用 扩香柑橘类配方时搭配两滴胡荽叶精油增添一抹清新、香甜的草本气息。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 内服：取一滴以120毫升的饮品搭配食用。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。
products.intro_en: Applied to the skin, Cilantro offers soothing and cooling benefits, and when diffused it pairs with any oil to add a fresh herbal note. Use topically to cleanse skin and nails or household surfaces. Cilantro also has countless culinary uses, adding creative flavour to meat dishes, salads, and dips.
products.claims_en: Pleasant, herbaceous, lemony aroma. Creates a fresh, uplifting atmosphere. Provides a soothing, relaxing sensation when applied topically. Effectively cleanses countertops.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Add one drop of Cilantro to mouthwash to freshen breath. Add one drop to your moisturizer to soothe dry skin and add a fresh scent. Apply one drop to the bottoms of feet before bed for a peaceful, fresh aroma. Apply one drop to fingernails and toenails to keep them clean and healthy-looking. Combine one to two drops with Fractionated Coconut Oil to massage skin for a soothing, calming effect. Internal use: Add a few drops to dips, salsa, or guacamole for a fresh herbal flavour. Home use: Add two drops to citrus diffuser blends for a fresh, sweet herbal note.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.
products.skin_en: Can be used on skin without dilution
products.desc_en: Why add Cilantro to your collection? Like other spice and herb oils, Cilantro enhances the flavour of food dishes. Beyond cooking, Cilantro shares the constituent linalool with other leafy herb oils such as Basil, which soothes the skin and offers surface-cleansing properties. Compared to other leafy herb oils, Cilantro is high in (E)-2-decenal, giving it a cooler, crisper aroma and stronger cleansing benefits.

products.intro_zh: doTERRA的莱姆精油以冷压法萃取自新鲜果皮，其香气与滋味皆令人感到清新、活力。您可以在您最喜欢的主菜、配菜和饮料加入莱姆精油，体验其鲜活、柑橘的风味。由于其局部清洁特性，莱姆精油也是您晚间个人护理程序的完美补充。莱姆精油因其净化的功效和振奋人心的香味而成为面部和身体清洁用品。
products.desc_zh: 为什么我要把莱姆精油纳入收藏? 独特的化学成分使莱姆精油香气满溢、芳香提振，其清洁功效亦归功于这化学成分。高浓度的柠檬烯增强莱姆精油的局部清洁功效和清新的柑橘香氛，扩香时可以清新空气。莱姆精油的另一种主要成分为β-蒎烯，赋予精油清新、令人振奋的香味。
products.tips_zh: 保养用 用一滴莱姆精油搭配晚间洁面乳一同使用为肌肤带来健康的光泽。 混合一滴莱姆精油与5滴分馏椰子油按摩指缘，使指甲和脚趾甲外观健康。 于少量洗发乳滴入一滴莱姆精油按摩头皮与头发增加清洁功效。 食用 于饮用水滴入两滴莱姆精油增添清新风味。 于沙沙酱、鳄梨酱或各种沾酱滴入一滴莱姆精油享受柑橘风味。 居家用 扩香三至四滴莱姆精油清新空气。 于抹布滴数滴莱姆精油帮助移除顽固黏腻的污渍。玻璃喷雾瓶中加入水再滴入10-15滴莱姆精油用于清洁桌面、流理台等各式表面。
products.directions_zh: 扩香: 在所选的喷雾器中使用三到四滴。 食用: 在120 毫升液体中稀释一滴。 外用: 涂抹一至两滴于所需部位。用基底油稀释以降低过敏可能。
products.cautions_zh: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。使用后12小时内请远离阳光或紫外线照射。
products.intro_en: Cold-pressed from fresh peels, dōTERRA Lime has a fresh, energizing aroma and flavour. Add Lime to your favourite entrées, side dishes, and beverages to experience its zesty citrus flavour. Thanks to its topical cleansing properties, Lime is also a perfect addition to your evening personal care routine. Its purifying benefits and uplifting scent make Lime a favourite in facial and body cleansers.
products.claims_en: Gives skin a healthy-looking glow. Cleanses hair and scalp. Add to water or recipes for a fresh citrus flavour. Cleanses surfaces and helps remove sticky residue.
products.tips_en: Personal use: Use one drop of Lime with your evening facial cleanser for a healthy-looking glow. Mix one drop of Lime with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil and massage into cuticles for healthy-looking fingernails and toenails. Add one drop to a small amount of shampoo and massage into scalp and hair for added cleansing. Internal use: Add two drops to drinking water for a fresh flavour. Add one drop to salsa, guacamole, or dips for a citrus flavour. Home use: Diffuse three to four drops to freshen the air. Place a few drops on a cloth to help remove stubborn, sticky residue. Add 10–15 drops of Lime to a glass spray bottle of water to clean tables, countertops, and other surfaces.
products.directions_en: Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice. Internal use: Dilute one drop in 4 fl. oz. (120 mL) of liquid. Topical use: Apply one to two drops to desired area. Dilute with a carrier oil to minimize any skin sensitivity.
products.cautions_en: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Avoid sunlight or UV rays for up to 12 hours after applying product.
products.skin_en: Dilute before use on sensitive skin
products.desc_en: Why add Lime to your collection? Lime's unique chemistry gives it a rich, uplifting aroma and is also responsible for its cleansing benefits. A high concentration of limonene enhances Lime's topical cleansing benefits and fresh citrus scent, and it freshens the air when diffused. Another main constituent of Lime, β-pinene, gives the oil a fresh, invigorating aroma.

products.origin: 由一种源自亚洲的高大香茅草蒸馏制成，香茅精油能为您的居家环境带来清脆的草本气息。
products.intro_zh: 由一种源自亚洲的高大香茅草蒸馏制成，香茅精油能为您的居家环境带来清脆的草本气息。它具有诸多应用方式，从舒缓肌肤以至于清洁居家台面，并且是户外活动的最佳良伴。
products.desc_zh: 香茅精油散发著清脆的柠檬气息，非常适合用于家中或身处户外时。凭借著其清新的气息和舒缓的功效，您可以在露营与远足时涂抹香茅精油，抑或是于露台上扩香使用。这款独特的精油含有香茅醛和香叶醇，这两种成分皆为清洁居家台面的绝佳天然解决方案。香叶醇—一种可见于天竺葵精油和玫瑰精油的成分—具有强大的肌肤舒缓功效，有助促进洁净、健康的肤况。将香茅精油用于居家清洁或个人护理的程序中，不仅可以增强清洁效力，更能带来悦人的清新香氛。
products.tips_zh: 户外聚会时，扩香使用以享悦人的草本气息。与基底油混合，涂抹于肌肤以享舒缓感受。与清水混合，喷洒于台面作为天然来源的台面清洁剂，并散发清新的草本气息。在进行户外活动时，涂抹于手臂和双脚，散发独特的个人香气。将一滴精油加入洗发乳和润发乳中，有助加强清洁效力并舒缓头皮。
products.directions_zh: 扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。 外用：将一到两滴涂抹在所需区域。涂抹时以基底油稀释减少皮肤过敏。
products.cautions_zh: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。放置处应远离孩童。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

With its fresh aroma and soothing benefits, you can apply Citronella while camping and hiking, or diffuse it on the patio. This unique oil contains citronellal and geraniol, both excellent natural solutions for cleaning household countertops. Geraniol, a constituent also found in Geranium and Rose oils, has powerful skin-soothing benefits that help promote clean, healthy-looking skin. Use Citronella in your home cleaning or personal care routine to enhance cleansing and enjoy a pleasant, fresh aroma.

recipes.usage_zh: 任选一种精油加入基础油中混合均匀，涂抹脊柱（几种精油也可交替使用）。
recipes.usage_en: Choose one oil and blend well into a carrier oil, then apply along the spine (the oils may also be rotated).

recipes.usage_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底；或将推荐精油按3:2:1的比例扩香。
recipes.usage_en: Before bed, apply to the head and soles of the feet, or diffuse the oils in a 3:2:1 ratio.

recipes.usage_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底；或将推荐精油按1:2:1的比例扩香。
recipes.usage_en: Before bed, apply to the head and soles of the feet, or diffuse the oils in a 1:2:1 ratio.

recipes.usage_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底；或将推荐精油按1:3:2的比例扩香。
recipes.usage_en: Before bed, apply to the head and soles of the feet, or diffuse the oils in a 1:3:2 ratio.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹头皮，少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to the scalp, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂于手心嗅吸，并涂抹太阳穴，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Rub into palms and inhale, then apply to the temples. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 可扩香，也可以涂抹在孩子的衣领上。
recipes.usage_en: Diffuse, or apply to your child's collar.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹太阳穴、手腕及后颈，少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to the temples, wrists and back of the neck, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹头皮，少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to the scalp, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹脊柱，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply along the spine. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹心前区和足底，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the chest over the heart and to the soles of the feet. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹耳后沟与脚底，并轻轻按摩。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the groove behind the ears and to the soles of the feet, and massage gently.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹并轻轻按摩颈部两侧，早晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply and gently massage into both sides of the neck, morning and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹头部和心前区，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the head and the chest over the heart. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹前胸，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the chest. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹前胸，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the chest. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹于腿部需要护理的部位和腰部，早晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the areas of the legs that need care and to the lower back, morning and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹鼻周并涂于手心嗅吸，少量多次；或将推荐精油按5:1:2的比例扩香。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount around the nose and rub into palms to inhale, several times a day; or diffuse the oils in a 5:1:2 ratio.

recipes.usage_zh: 任选一组配方，涂抹眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Choose either blend and apply around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），每天少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹眼眶周围，注意避开眼睛，少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹眼袋部位（注意避开眼睛），少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to the under-eye area, keeping away from the eyes, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹眼周（避开眼皮及眼睛），早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply around the eyes, avoiding the eyelids and eyes. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹并轻轻按摩眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply and gently massage around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹并轻轻按摩眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply and gently massage around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹并轻轻按摩眼眶周围（注意避开眼睛），早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply and gently massage around the eye socket, keeping away from the eyes. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 可随时涂抹并轻轻按摩耳朵周围。
recipes.usage_en: Apply and gently massage around the ears at any time.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹耳朵周围，早中晚各1次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply around the ears. Morning, midday and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹唇部皮肤，少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to the lips, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 用干净的手指蘸取，点涂于口腔内需要护理的部位，少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: With a clean finger, dab onto the area inside the mouth that needs care, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 每天早晚涂抹后背脊柱和脚底。
recipes.usage_en: Apply along the spine and to the soles of the feet, morning and evening.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹脖颈至前胸，以及后背。
recipes.usage_en: Apply from the neck down to the chest, and to the back.

recipes.usage_zh: 一日数次，涂抹胃腹部。排便不畅时顺时针按摩，便稀时逆时针按摩。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the tummy several times a day. Massage clockwise when bowel movements are sluggish, and counter-clockwise when stools are loose.

recipes.usage_zh: 每日少量多次（4-6次），涂抹需要护理的肌肤。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to skin that needs care, 4–6 times a day.
recipes.carrier: 150g无香乳液稀释（薰衣草可换蓝艾菊）

recipes.usage_zh: 每日少量多次，涂抹需要护理的肌肤。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to skin that needs care, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 涂抹心前区，每日少量多次。
recipes.usage_en: Apply a small amount to the chest over the heart, several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 每日多次涂抹喉颈、前胸及心前区。
recipes.usage_en: Apply to the throat, chest and the area over the heart several times a day.

recipes.usage_zh: 每次使用前摇匀，再喷洒即可。
recipes.usage_en: Shake well before each use, then spray.

pains.zh: 肩颈/腰背酸痛、肌肉紧绷
